# Colombia Statutory Report Specifications - seven Report Specs (CO-DIAN-004 v1.3; CO-DIAN-002 and CO-PILA-007 v1.1; the others v1.2)

Every sheet of the seven delivered Colombia report specifications (Version Control, Report Matrix, Payroll Scope Summary, the field spec, File Structure, Field Options, Population Rules, Example Analysis, Sample File): electronic payroll, Form 350, PILA employees, Form 220, Format 2276, annual severance-savings deposit and PILA pensioners.

This file is a complete, verbatim conversion of the artifacts above (python-docx / openpyxl, cached cell values; empty columns dropped; the first column `Row` of each table is the Excel row number, so a citation such as "WTC row 156, column Q" can be checked against the workbook). Figures, dates, codes, Spanish terminology and legal citations are reproduced exactly as delivered; nothing is summarised or rounded. The only change: the name of the client whose wage-type labels appear in a few rows is replaced by `[client]`.


## Reading notes (added at compilation, 2026-11-02)

The seven filings (CO-DIAN-004 at version 1.3 and four specs at version 1.2, issued 2026-11-02; CO-DIAN-002 and CO-PILA-007
at version 1.1, issued 2026-10-30):

| Spec ID | Filing | Authority / channel | Frequency | Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **CO-DIAN-001** | Documento Soporte de Pago de Nómina Electrónica (+ Nota de Ajuste) | DIAN - SOAP 1.2 web service (machine-to-machine) | Monthly, one document per employee per month | First ten days of the following month (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.4.1.1) |
| **CO-DIAN-002** | Formulario 350 - Declaración mensual de retenciones en la fuente | DIAN - Muisca portal (no upload file) | Monthly | 7th-16th business day, by the last NIT digit (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.33) |
| **CO-PILA-003** | PILA - employees (Anexo Técnico 2 v30, Res. MSPS 1529 de 2026) | Licensed private operador de información | Monthly | 2nd-16th business day, by the last two digits of the NIT (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.2.1) |
| **CO-DIAN-004** | Formulario 220 - Certificado de ingresos y retenciones | Issued to each employee; not filed with DIAN | Annual | Last business day of March of the following year (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.40) |
| **CO-DIAN-005** | Formato 2276 - Información exógena, rentas de trabajo y pensiones | DIAN - exógena service (XML) | Annual | May-June of the following year, by NIT (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.3.9.1.3) |
| **CO-CESANTIAS-006** | Consignación anual de cesantías | Severance-savings fund, through an operator (not a government authority) | Annual | Before 15 February of the following year (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3) |
| **CO-PILA-007** | PILA - pensioners paid by the employer (Anexo Técnico 3 v15) | Licensed private operador de información | Monthly | Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.2.1 bands |

- The deadlines above are the rule; the exact calendar dates of each year come from the annual DIAN / Ministry calendars.
- Inbound / non-filed: Formulario 220 is a certificate issued to the employee, not a filing. The MinTrabajo disability-hiring
  report is out of the payroll scope (HR scope) and has no spec.
- Formato 2276 XML element names remain **DERIVED**: the DIAN technical annex / XSD for format 2276 v4 was not obtained.
- The electronic payroll document carries **no negative amount** (DIAN Concepto 014745 de 2025); corrections go by adjustment
  note (TipoXML 103).
- The *Example Analysis* and *Sample File* sheets use synthetic employers and employees.
- Version 1.2 (2026-11-02): 790 / 1,340 UVT caps tracked year-to-date (CO-DIAN-001, CO-DIAN-004); severance savings and their
  interest not withheld for non-residents (CO-DIAN-001, -004, -005, CO-CESANTIAS-006); Form 220 casilla 59 / Format 2276 six-month
  average 12,000,000 in the examples; PILA occupational-risk rate T2R2-061 as a decimal with a point (0.0052200) (CO-PILA-003);
  CO-DIAN-001 NIE066-NIE068 (bank, account type, account number) populated for the account-crediting payment methods 42, 45,
  47 and 98 (48 / 49 only for a card linked to a salary account), the same list as the DD Payment Method mapper.
- Version 1.3 of CO-DIAN-004 (2026-11-02, text only): the non-withholding of severance savings for non-residents cites
  Constitutional Court C-397 de 1994 and DIAN Concepto 577 de 2020 (Report Matrix row 34, Example Analysis row 34).

### Sheet: Report Matrix

ELECTRONIC PAYROLL SUPPORT DOCUMENT — REPORT MATRIX  

| Row | Report ID | CO-DIAN-001 |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Report Name (EN) | Electronic Payroll Support Document |
| 5 | Report Name (Local) | Documento Soporte de Pago de Nomina Electronica |
| 6 | Document ID | CO-DIAN-001 |
| 7 | Document Title | Electronic Payroll Support Document - Field Specification |
| 8 | Country | Colombia |
| 9 | Authority | National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) |
| 10 | Report Type | Statutory electronic tax document, one per employee per month |
| 11 | Tax Type | Payroll source document underlying income-tax withholding and social-security reporting |
| 12 | Relationship | Employer to DIAN, machine-to-machine |
| 13 | Frequency | Monthly - ONE document per employee per month, irrespective of the pay cycle (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2) |
| 14 | Submission Deadline | FIRST TEN DAYS of the month following the payment or credit in account (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.4.1.1) |
| 15 | File Format | XML (UBL 2.1) |
| 16 | File Extension | .xml |
| 17 | Character Encoding | UTF-8 - mandatory; any other encoding is rejected (Annex v1.0 rule ZB03) |
| 18 | Record Types / Sections | SOAP 1.2 envelope; NominaIndividual and NominaIndividualDeAjuste document types |
| 19 | Version | v1.2 |
| 22 | DETAILED COMPLIANCE NOTES (Colombia-specific) |  |
| 23 | SUBMISSION CHANNEL |  |
| 24 | - Channel: xml (machine-to-machine) \| Portal: DIAN Sistema de Validacion y Gestion de Documents, catalogo-vpfe.dian.gov.co \| Source: Technical Annex v1.0 s.9.3 to s.9.8 (SOAP 1.2, Document/Literal, TLS 1.2 mutual authentication, WS-Security 1.0 X.509 Token Profile 1.1). |  |
| 25 | - This is the ONE Colombian payroll filing that is genuinely machine-to-machine. It inverts the Colombian default: Form 350, Form 220 and Format 2276 are portal round-trips, and PILA is filed through a licensed private information operator. Do not generalise the M2M posture from this filing to the others. |  |
| 26 | - Operation SendNominaSync takes a single parameter, wcf:contentFile, carrying the base64 of a ZIP that contains the signed XML. Maximum 500 KB. Annex s.9.5 and s.9.7.2 print the exact envelope, reproduced on Sheet 9. |  |
| 27 | - Enablement (habilitacion) with DIAN is a PROJECT PREREQUISITE with a lead time, not a configuration step: global validation rule 92 rejects any document from a non-enabled issuer, and rule 90 permits a given document number only once per employee. |  |
| 28 | INTEGRATION TYPE AND DIRECTION |  |
| 29 | - Integration: outbound file generation and inbound response handling. Outbound: the signed XML. Inbound: the synchronous base64 ApplicationResponse in the same call. |  |
| 30 | - The inbound leg (CO-IN-NE-APPRESPONSE) is specified in this workbook rather than in a separate file, because it is not an independent government-to-employer flow - it is the response half of a single synchronous exchange and shares this filing's identifiers. See the section 'INBOUND - DIAN VALIDATION RESPONSE' on the Spec sheet. |  |
| 31 | - product_mapping_required = true. The XML separates salary from non-salary at ELEMENT level with paired S / NS element names, so every wage type carries a salary / non-salary attribute in the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). The engine reads that attribute; the split is never derived at reporting time from the amount, the description or the wage-type name. |  |
| 32 | RESIDENT / NON-RESIDENT TREATMENT |  |
| 33 | - RESIDENT: RetencionFuente (NIE177) carries the ET art. 383 progressive table (0 / 19 / 28 / 33 / 35 / 37 / 39% on the tax-unit bands 0-95, 95-150, 150-360, 360-640, 640-945, 945-2,300, above 2,300 UVT), applied to the art. 388 depurated monthly base under Procedure 1 or Procedure 2. |  |
| 34 | - NON-RESIDENT: RetencionFuente (NIE177) carries the FLAT 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS payment - no art. 388 depuration, no 25% exempt income, no art. 387 deductions, no tax-free band. Confirmed by DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026, upholding Concept 1789 (int. 14595) of 2025. |  |
| 35 | - The XML has NO residence attribute. Residence is therefore invisible to DIAN in this document and visible only through the amount in NIE177 and, on Form 350, through the sheet-2 payments-al-exterior section. The engine must carry a residence flag with an effective date on the employee record, re-evaluate it EVERY period, and switch the schedule PROSPECTIVELY from the payment following the date the 183-day test is met. Never retroactively - there is no payroll true-up of the earlier months. |  |
| 36 | - Where the non-resident's work is performed ENTIRELY outside Colombia the income is foreign-source and not subject to withholding at all (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019); LugarTrabajoPais (NIE050) is the field that signals this. |  |
| 37 | - Treaty relief can reduce or eliminate the 20% where a double-tax treaty assigns taxing rights to the residence state. Mercans applies treaty relief ONLY on written client instruction supported by a residence certificate. |  |
| 38 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 39 | - The monthly sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across all employees must reconcile to Form 350 casilla 93 (withholdings - employment income, natural persons) plus casilla 94 (withholdings - pension income) for the same period - CO-DIAN-002. |  |
| 40 | - Salud (NIE163), FondoPension (NIE166) and FondoSP (NIE168 / NIE170) must reconcile to the corresponding PILA Record Tipo 2 fields 55, 47 and 51 / 52 - CO-PILA-003 - subject to the different rounding conventions. |  |
| 41 | - Severance savings (NIE120) and PagoIntereses (NIE122) feed Form 220 casillas 47-49 and Format 2276 numerals 18-20 - CO-DIAN-004 and CO-DIAN-005. |  |
| 42 | - The annual accumulation of every Earnings element feeds Form 220 casillas 36-52 and Format 2276 numerals 5-22. |  |
| 43 | - The graphical representation (payslip) is PERMISSIVE under Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.3, but if issued it must carry the thirteen items of art. 1.5.3.3.1 and a QR of at least 2 cm on EVERY page. Colombia has NO statutory payslip-content article in its labour code - the itemisation rule is this tax resolution. See 06-payslip. |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - ELECTRONIC PAYROLL SUPPORT DOCUMENT  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHO gets a Electronic Payroll Support Document each month and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Indefinite-term employee (indefinite-term contract) | YES | The core private-sector population. CST art. 47; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 5. |
| 7 | Fixed-term employee (fixed-term contract, max 4 years) | YES | Identical reporting treatment to an indefinite-term contract. CST art. 46; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6. |
| 8 | Specific-work or task employee (contract por obra o labor) | YES | An employment contract; CST art. 46. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 3 (Obra o Labor). |
| 9 | Occasional / accidental / transitory worker (< 1 month, non-core activity) | YES | Still an employee under CST art. 6. Reported on every filing; the PILA return type and the day counts differ, not the obligation. |
| 10 | Part-time employee | YES | Colombia has no separate part-time regime. Reported normally; the PILA contribution base is floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) except for the worker type 51 partial-time regime. |
| 11 | All-inclusive salary employee (all-inclusive salary, >= 13 SMMLV) | YES | CST art. 132 num. 2. Reported with the integral-salary flag set; the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, and the electronic payroll carries SalarioIntegral = true. |
| 12 | Apprentice (apprenticeship contract) | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19). |
| 13 | Intern / practical placement (practicas o pasantias) | YES | Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 5. Reported where remunerated. |
| 14 | Teleworkers and remote workers | YES | Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158). |
| 15 | Resident foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | Full reporting. Withheld under the ET art. 383 progressive table once tax residence is acquired. |
| 16 | NON-RESIDENT foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix. |
| 17 | Employed old-age pensioner in active service | YES | PILA worker sub-type 01; no pension contribution (PILA pension rate field = 0), health and the levies still apply. |
| 18 | Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract | YES | Reported as an ordinary employee where an employment contract exists. |
| 19 | Independent contractor (service contract) | NO | Not an employee. The contractor self-files PILA on 40% of fees (return types I / Y, descoped) and is reported by the payer in the third-party information return, not in this employer filing. Withholding on their fees does pass through Form 350, but under a different casilla. |
| 20 | Public-sector employee (contributor type 47, SGP-funded entity) | NO | Public-sector only. The PILA return types T and F of public-sector entities are outside the scope of this payroll, so worker type 47 is never emitted. |
| 21 | Non-executive director paid fees only (junta directiva) | NO | Fees of a non-executive director (honorarios de junta directiva) are not derived from an employment relationship, so they are outside the document, which supports only payments derived from an employment or statutory relationship and pensions borne by the employer (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.1). They are paid and withheld outside payroll and reported by the payer in the third-party information return, as for an independent contractor (see the contractor row). A director who also holds an employment contract is reported for that contract only (see the executive-director row). |
| 22 | Pensioner: pension paid by a fund, or paid directly by the employer | VARIES | Paid by a fund: NO - the paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. Paid directly by the employer (pensioner 'a cargo del empleador'): YES - the document supports the payments 'que se desprenden de una relación laboral o legal y reglamentaria y los pensionados a cargo del empleador', the employer that makes payments 'a los pensionados a cargo del empleador' is obliged to issue it, and the pensioner is a beneficiary of the payment (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 arts. 1.5.3.2.1, 1.5.3.2.3 and 1.5.3.1.1 num. 5). |
| 23 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 24 | Basic salary for the days worked | YES | SueldoTrabajado (NIE070). The single largest input to every downstream filing. |
| 25 | Statutory transport allowance | YES | AuxilioTransporte (NIE071), where the employee earns up to 2 SMMLV. Not salary for contributions, but IS in the base of cesantias, interest on cesantias and prima (Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7); not in the base of the CST art. 64 dismissal indemnity. |
| 26 | Overtime and premium hours, itemised by type with times and percentages | YES | Seven separate hour-type blocks (table 5.5.5), each with start time, end time, quantity, percentage and amount. A single aggregated 'overtime' figure is NOT admissible. |
| 27 | Vacation taken and vacation compensated in cash, as separate elements | YES | VacacionesComunes and VacacionesCompensadas. They must not be merged. Vacation paid in cash (during employment or on termination) is NOT part of the IBC for health, pension and occupational risk (Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 26941 of 2024-04-04; unification ruling exp. 25185 of 2021, rule 1), while for enjoyed vacation days health and pension are contributed on the IBC of the month before the vacation starts (DUR 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.5.1; Consejo de Estado, Sección Cuarta, exp. 25958 of 2022). Both enjoyed vacation and vacation paid in cash ARE part of the parafiscal base for CCF, SENA and ICBF (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17; Ley 89 de 1988 art. 1 par. 1; Consejo de Estado, Sala de Consulta, concept 2027 of 2010). |
| 28 | Service bonus, severance savings and interest on severance savings | YES | Primas, Severance savings and Cesantias/@PagoIntereses. Reported here even though severance savings are excluded from the monthly withholding base. |
| 29 | Incapacity, maternity / paternity leave and paid leave | YES | Each with its own dates, quantity and amount, and - for incapacity - its type code. |
| 30 | Unpaid leave and lawful strike | YES | Reported as days ONLY. Both blocks deliberately carry no amount element. |
| 31 | Benefits in kind (salary in kind) | YES | Through the paired OtroConcepto S / NS elements or the specific allowance elements. Valued contractually or by expert appraisal; Colombia has no notional valuation scale. |
| 32 | Employer social-security contributions | NO | The document reports what the EMPLOYEE accrued and what was DEDUCTED from the employee. The employer's 12% pension, 8.5% health, occupational-risk premium and 9% levies are an employer cost reported on PILA, never a deduction here. |
| 33 | Employer payroll levies (SENA 2%, ICBF 3%, CCF 4%) | NO | Employer cost, reported on PILA. Never an employee deduction. |
| 34 | Documented business-expense reimbursements | NO | A reimbursement of an expense the employee incurred on the employer's behalf, supported by the supplier's document, is not remuneration (CST art. 128: amounts received not for the employee's benefit but to carry out the job, such as transport, work tools and similar, are not salary) and is not an accrual of the employee; it is settled through accounts payable, not through this document. Per diems for meals and lodging ARE reported, in ViaticoManuAlojS (permanent, salary) or ViaticoManuAlojNS (accidental, non-salary) - NIE072 / NIE073. |
| 35 | Amounts in a currency other than the Colombian peso | NO | Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.8.5 makes the peso mandatory. A foreign currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted; the TRM element (NIE200) exists in the schema but is out of scope for a Colombian payroll. |
| 36 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 37 | Reported on the accrual (causacion) date | NO | Every Colombian payroll filing is keyed to the PAYMENT or credit-in-account date, not to the accrual date. A December salary paid in January falls in the January filing. |
| 38 | Reported on the payment or credit-in-account date | YES | The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276. |
| 39 | A semi-monthly payroll produces two filings a month | NO | It does not. The electronic payroll is expressly ONE monthly document per employee 'irrespective of whether the obliged party makes payments in different or shorter periods' (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2). PILA and Form 350 are likewise monthly. |
| 40 | Nil period still filed | NO | The document is the support of the payments or credits in account made to the employee in the month (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 arts. 1.5.3.2.1 and 1.5.3.2.2); it is not a periodic return. Where no payment or credit in account is made to an employee in the month (for example a full-month unpaid leave or suspension), no document is generated for that employee, and there is no nil document at employer level. Where payments exist but the deductions absorb them, a document IS generated with ComprobanteTotal 0.00 (see the zero-net-pay row). |
| 41 | Corrections handled by re-filing the whole period | VARIES | Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8). |
| 42 | **═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══** |  |  |
| 43 | Employee with zero net pay (deductions equal accrued) | YES | A document is still required. ComprobanteTotal (NIE189) is 0.00; the accrued and deducted blocks are fully itemised. |
| 44 | Employee whose withholding falls in the 0% band | YES | The payment is still reported. RetencionFuente (NIE177) is simply omitted rather than zero-filled. |
| 45 | Mid-month hire or mid-month leaver | YES | DiasTrabajados (NIE069) is reduced; FechaIngreso or FechaRetiro is set; TiempoLaborado is computed to the settlement end on the 360/30 convention. |
| 46 | Second employer of a multi-employer employee | YES | Each employer issues its own document for its own payments. There is no aggregation across employers at document level. |
| 47 | Employee paid semi-monthly | YES | ONE monthly document carrying PeriodoNomina = 4 (Fortnightly) and TWO FechaPago (NIE203) occurrences. Not two documents. |
| 48 | Correction of a document already validated by DIAN | YES | By adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste), never by re-sending the original number - global rule 90 forbids reuse. |
| 49 | Employee holding a PPT (Temporary protection permit) | YES | Reported. Annex table 5.2.1 has no code for the PPT (Decree 216 of 2021 post-dates the annex); a PPT holder is reported with code 47, the residence-permit code of the table, and the PPT number in NumeroDocumento; a PEP holder is reported with code 47, the PEP code of the table (see NIE044). |

PERSISTENCE: the CUNE is immutable once the document is validated. Any change to any of the eleven inputs produces a different CUNE and therefore a different document; corrections are made by an adjustment note carrying its own CUNE and referencing the original. | N | - | Not an amount - no rounding. | N | Identifier | Per document |  |  |

### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ FILE FORMAT ═══  

| Row | File type | XML 1.0. The signature area uses OASIS UBL 2.1; every other section uses DIAN's own structure as published in the Technical Annex. This is a REAL XML submission with a published schema - not a portal form - so the wire format below is the actual submission format, not a logical model. |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Schema | XSD version 1.0.6, referenced by Technical Annex version 1.0. Root elements: NominaIndividual (TipoXML 102) and NominaIndividualDeAjuste (TipoXML 103). |
| 5 | Character encoding | UTF-8 ONLY. Annex s.9.7.1. Any other encoding is rejected at unzip time. |
| 6 | Transport packaging | The XML is placed in a ZIP; the ZIP is base64-encoded; the base64 string is the single wcf:contentFile parameter of SendNominaSync. |
| 7 | Maximum size | Maximum 500 KB per XML document (rule ZA01, rejection: 'Tamano del mensaje superior al limite establecido'; Anexo Tecnico NE v1.0 s.6.2.1). |
| 8 | Signature | XAdES-EPES enveloped signature inside /NominaIndividual/UBLExtensions/UBLExtension/ExtensionContent/ds:Signature, using an X.509 certificate from a certification authority accredited by ONAC. The ClaimedRole must be thirdparty or supplier (Annex s.7). |
| 9 | Decimal convention | Two decimals, decimal POINT, no thousand separators, no currency symbol. Rounding is round-half-to-even; validation tolerance is +/- 2.00. |
| 10 | Date / time convention | Dates AAAA-MM-DD. Times HH:MM:SS with the GMT offset, always -05:00 for Colombia (no daylight saving). Overtime start / end times use the 19-character form AAAA-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. |
| 11 | **═══ TRANSPORT - SOAP 1.2 WEB SERVICE (ANNEX S.9) ═══** |  |
| 12 | Protocol | SOAP 1.2, Style/Encoding Document/Literal, over HTTPS with TLS 1.2 and MUTUAL authentication by digital certificate. |
| 13 | Security model | WS-Security 1.0 (OASIS) with X.509 Certificate Token Profile 1.1. |
| 14 | Namespaces | soap = http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope ; wcf = http://wcf.dian.colombia |
| 15 | Submission operation | SendNominaSync - one parameter, wcf:contentFile, carrying the base64 of the ZIP. Synchronous. |
| 16 | Response action | http://wcf.dian.colombia/IWcfDianCustomerServices/SendNominaSyncResponse |
| 17 | Query operation | GetStatus - retrieves the status of a document already transmitted (Annex s.9.8). |
| 18 | Server-side checks, in order | 1. ZIP is not empty. 2. ZIP is not corrupt. 3. The UBL 2.1 signed section exists. 4. The document matches the NominaIndividual or NominaIndividualDeAjuste XSD. 5. No error against the Annex's own structural rules. Only then is the ApplicationResponse produced. |

| 138 | **═══ CONTROL MECHANISMS ═══** |  |
| 139 | CUNE (Annex s.8.1) | SHA-384 of NumNE + FecNE + HorNE + ValDev + ValDed + ValTolNE + NitNE + DocEmp + TipoXML + Software-Pin + TipAmb, concatenated with no separators. Money inputs are TRUNCATED to two decimals, not rounded. Result is 96 lower-case hexadecimal characters. |
| 140 | SoftwareSC (Annex s.8.2) | SHA-384 of SoftwareID + PIN + document number. Changes with every document, unlike SoftwareID. |
| 141 | TiempoLaborado (Annex s.8.3.1) | Days on the 360/30 commercial convention: (years x 360) + (months x 30) + odd days. Annex example: 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = 1908.00. |
| 142 | QR (Annex s.13.1) | URL of the DIAN document-search service keyed on the CUNE. If a graphical representation is issued, the QR must be at least 2 cm x 2 cm on EVERY page. |
| 143 | Key validation rules | NIE022 - the Version literal must be exactly 'V1.0: Documento Soporte de Pago de Nómina Electrónica'. Global rule 90 - a document number may be transmitted only ONCE per employee. Global rule 92 - a document from a non-enabled issuer is rejected. Full rule set at Annex s.6.1. |

| 65 | (statutory rate) | - | - | STATUTORY RATE REPORTED. The annex percentages for codes 4, 5, 6 and 7 embed the pre-reform 75% Sunday / public-holiday premium. Law 2466 of 2025 art. 14 (CST art. 179) sets that premium at 80% from 1 July 2025, 90% from 1 July 2026 and 100% from 1 July 2027 (or 100% from the outset at the employer's option). The annex is still at version 1.0 and table 5.5.5 has not been reissued. DIAN Concepto 013840 int. 1568 of 1 October 2025: the table percentage 'debe leerse en consonancia con la normatividad vigente para cada caso específico', employers report the surcharges 'liquidados con el porcentaje aplicable según la normatividad vigente', and different percentages within one month do not prevent the generation, transmission and validation of the document. @Porcentaje therefore carries the statutory percentage from the configured rate table, split by date where a month straddles 1 July. |

### Sheet: Population Rules

POPULATION RULES - HOW TO FILL EACH FIELD FROM PAYROLL  

| Row | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | **═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 4 | Version (NIE022) | Configuration | Emit the constant string 'V1.0: Documento Soporte de Pago de Nómina Electrónica' exactly, including accents and the colon-space. Never build it from a version variable, never trim, never transliterate. Validation rule NIE022 compares the whole literal. | A configuration file saved as ASCII will silently strip the accent on 'Nomina' and every document will be rejected. |
| 5 | Numero (NIE012) | Engine sequence + configuration | Concatenate the issuer-chosen Prefix (NIE010) with the next unused Sequence number (NIE011), the consecutive also being assigned by the issuer (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.3.1 num. 5), with no separator. Persist the last-used consecutive per prefix range in a transactional store, and increment it BEFORE transmission, never after, so that a failed transmission does not leave a reusable number. Global rule 90 permits a given number only once per employee. | Precaution: treat a rejected document's number as consumed. Global rule 90 only blocks a number already 'procesado anteriormente' (annex p.182), and the annex does not say whether a number from a rejected document may be reused; to be safe, the replacement document carries a NEW consecutive and a rejected number is not re-sent. |
| 6 | CUNE (NIE024) | Engine (computed) | Compute SHA-384 over the eleven inputs concatenated with no separators, in the published order: Numero, FechaGen, HoraGen (with the -05:00 offset), DevengadosTotal, DeduccionesTotal, ComprobanteTotal, employer NIT (no DV), employee document number, TipoXML, the secret software PIN, and Ambiente. The three money inputs must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - not rounded - and written with a decimal point, no thousand separators and no currency symbol. Emit the result as 96 lower-case hexadecimal characters. | The four classic failures: (1) rounding instead of truncating the money inputs; (2) omitting the -05:00 offset from HoraGen; (3) including the employer DV in NitNE; (4) using the SoftwareID instead of the PIN. All four produce a well-formed but wrong CUNE. |
| 7 | SoftwareSC (NIE020) | Engine (computed) | Compute SHA-384 over SoftwareID + PIN + document number. Recompute for EVERY document, because the document number is an input. Do not cache it at software level. | Caching SoftwareSC as if it were a constant is a common error - it is constant only for a single document. |
| 8 | TiempoLaborado (NIE006) | Engine (computed) | Compute cumulative service from FechaIngreso to FechaLiquidacionFin on the Colombian commercial convention: 1 year = 360 days, 1 month = 30 days. Decompose the elapsed period into whole years, whole months and residual days, then evaluate (years x 360) + (months x 30) + days. Emit with two decimals. The annex's own example is 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = 1908.00. | Do NOT use a calendar day-count. A naive (date2 - date1).days gives 1913 for the annex's own example instead of 1908, and DIAN will not flag it - the error surfaces only in a seniority dispute. |
| 9 | DiasTrabajados (NIE069) | Payroll engine | DiasTrabajados = days the worker actually worked in the settlement period, on the 30-day commercial month. Days of incapacity, maternity / paternity leave, paid and unpaid leave and vacation are NOT counted here; they are reported in their own blocks (Incapacidad/@Cantidad, LicenciaMP, LicenciaR, LicenciaNR, Vacaciones). Suspension and lawful-strike days are not worked either (Anexo Tecnico NE v1.0 NIE069: 'efectivamente estuvo ejecutando sus labores'; NIE125, NIE130, NIE134, NIE138). | February always counts 30 days in Colombian payroll, rather than 28. A 31-day month also counts 30. |
| 10 | **═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 11 | DevengadosTotal / DeduccionesTotal / ComprobanteTotal (NIE187-NIE189) | Engine (computed) | DevengadosTotal is the sum of every populated element in the Earnings block; DeduccionesTotal is the sum of every populated element in Deductions; ComprobanteTotal is DevengadosTotal minus DeduccionesTotal, adjusted for the Rounding residual. Each element is first rounded half-to-even to two decimals, then summed - not summed and then rounded. Where a residual remains, disclose it in Rounding (NIE186) rather than absorbing it into a concept. Validation tolerance is +/- 2.00. | Summing unrounded values and rounding the total produces a figure that ties to the cent but does not match the sum of the printed lines on the payslip. Round first, then sum. |
| 12 | Salary / non-salary paired elements | Wage-type configuration | Every paired element (ViaticoManuAlojS / NS, BonificacionS / NS, AuxilioS / NS, ConceptoS / NS, PagoS / NS, PagoAlimentacionS / NS, Primas Payment / PagoNS) is driven by the salary / non-salary attribute of the wage type in the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). Never infer the split at reporting time from the amount, the description or the wage-type name. | The 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 depends on this split, as does the contribution base. An inference error propagates into PILA and into the employer cost. |
| 13 | Employer contributions must never appear in Deductions | Wage-type configuration | The Deductions block reports only what was withheld FROM THE EMPLOYEE. The employer's 12% pension, 8.5% health, occupational-risk premium and the 9% payroll levies (SENA 2%, ICBF 3%, CCF 4%) are employer costs reported on PILA. Configure them on a cost, not a deduction, wage-type class so they cannot leak into this block. | A single mis-classified employer wage type inflates DeduccionesTotal and understates ComprobanteTotal, which then disagrees with the actual bank payment. |
| 14 | Solidarity fund must not be merged into pension | Wage-type configuration | FondoSP carries FOUR attributes - the solidarity rate and amount, and the subsistence rate and amount. They are validated independently of FondoPension. Configure the solidarity surcharge as its own wage type from the outset. | This is the single most common Colombian mapping error. Merging produces a 5% 'pension' line that fails reconciliation against PILA fields 47, 51 and 52. |
| 15 | Overtime cannot be aggregated | Payroll engine | Emit one element per contiguous block of hours of a single type. Split a block that crosses 19:00 or midnight, because the applicable code changes. Populate quantity, percentage and amount for every block, plus start and end times where the time register carries them. | A block that crosses the 19:00 boundary but is emitted as a single HED element misstates both the code and the premium. |
| 16 | **═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 17 | All monetary elements | Engine (formatting) | Two decimals, decimal POINT, no thousand separator, no currency symbol, no leading plus sign. Rounding is round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401), not half-up. No monetary value may be negative, Redondeo (NIE186) included (rule VLR01, rejection; Anexo Tecnico NE v1.0 s.1.1.3.1; DIAN Concepto 014745 of 2025). A downward difference for a past period is corrected with a NominaIndividualDeAjuste (Reemplazar) of that period, never with a negative amount. | A locale-aware formatter will emit a comma decimal separator in an es-CO locale and the document will fail schema validation. |
| 18 | Three rounding conventions coexist | Engine (formatting) | The XML uses two decimals round-half-to-even. PILA rounds the base UP to the peso and each contribution UP to the next multiple of 100. Form 350 rounds to the nearest 1,000. The same health contribution therefore legitimately appears as three different numbers in three artefacts. Store the unrounded value once and apply each convention at output time. | Never display the PILA figure on the payslip as if it were the deduction. Where the PILA figure is shown on the payslip, it must be a separate, labelled line (CCG Module 10.3). |
| 19 | Percentage attributes | Configuration | Rate attributes (NIE077 and the other six @Porcentaje, NIE161, NIE164, NIE167, NIE169, NIE121, NIE171) carry the rate itself, expressed to two decimals - 4.00 rather than 0.04, 25.00 rather than 0.25. | Emitting 0.04 for the 4% health rate passes schema validation and produces a document that is internally inconsistent with @Deduccion. |
| 20 | **═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 21 | RetencionFuente (NIE177) - RESIDENT | Payroll engine (tax) | Build the ET art. 388 depurated base: gross taxable payments, less the mandatory health, pension and solidarity-fund contributions (ingresos no constitutivos de renta), less the art. 387 deductions elected by the employee (dependants at 10% of gross capped at 32 UVT per month, prepaid health up to 16 UVT per month, housing-loan interest up to 100 UVT per month), less the 25% exempt income of art. 206 num. 10. Apply the two caps: deductions plus exempt income may not exceed 40% of gross less non-constitutive income, nor 1,340 UVT per year. The 790-UVT and 1,340-UVT limits are annual and are tracked year-to-date per employee: each month only the part not yet used in the year is available (no monthly one-twelfth limit: Consejo de Estado, Seccion Cuarta, rad. 24047 of 2021; Decreto 2231 de 2023 art. 9). Convert the resulting base to UVT at 52,374, read the art. 383 table, convert back to pesos (two decimals). The monthly withholding is not rounded per employee: the approximation to the nearest 1,000 applies only to the Form 350 return values (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.11.11). Under Procedure 2 apply instead the fixed percentage recomputed each June and December on the preceding twelve months divided by 13. | Exclude severance savings and the interest on them from the monthly base under BOTH procedures (art. 206 num. 4). Under Procedure 1 the statutory minimum service bonus gets its OWN separate read of the table (art. 385) and does not merge into the ordinary base. For a sub-30-day period apply the art. 385 rule: gross the payments to 30 days, read the table for a PERCENTAGE, then apply that percentage to the actual smaller payment - never read the table for an amount on the grossed-up figure. |
| 22 | RetencionFuente (NIE177) - NON-RESIDENT | Payroll engine (tax) | Apply a FLAT 20% to the GROSS payment under ET art. 408. Do not depurate: no deduction of the mandatory contributions, no art. 387 deductions, no 25% exempt income, no tax-free band, no Procedure 1 or 2 election. This applies to salary, to the service bonus, to dismissal indemnity, to equity income and to benefits in kind alike. Severance savings and their interest are never withheld, for residents and non-residents alike (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11; DIAN Oficios 8899 de 2015 and 4358 de 2019); a client may configure the conservative 20% for them (option, off by default). Carry a residence flag with an effective date on the employee record, re-evaluate it EVERY period against the art. 10 test (more than 183 days in any 365-day period), and switch to the art. 383 table PROSPECTIVELY from the payment following the date the test is met. | Never apply the switch retroactively and never true up the earlier months through payroll - DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026 expressly rejects anticipating future residence. The employee reconciles on their own return. Where the work is performed ENTIRELY outside Colombia the income is foreign-source and there is no withholding at all; LugarTrabajoPais (NIE050) is the field that signals this. Treaty relief is applied ONLY on written client instruction with a residence certificate. |
| 23 | AuxilioTransporte (NIE071) | Payroll engine | Emit only where the employee's salary does not exceed 2 SMMLV (COP 3,501,810 in 2026). The 2026 amount is COP 249,095 per month, prorated by days worked. Where the employee is above the threshold, OMIT the element rather than emitting zero. | The allowance is NOT salary for contribution purposes but IS included in the base of cesantias, interest on cesantias and prima (Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7); it is not in the base of the CST art. 64 dismissal indemnity (salary, CST art. 127). Carrying a single 'transport' wage type with one base flag will get one of the two treatments wrong. |
| 24 | Cesantias (NIE120) and PagoIntereses (NIE122) | Payroll engine | Cesantias accrue at one month's salary per year of service, on salary plus the transport allowance. Interest accrues at 12% per annum on the 31 December balance and is paid TO THE EMPLOYEE during January. Where the employer has adopted the Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 64 option, the 8.33% is deposited monthly and the 1% interest paid monthly, by written agreement - a configurable engine option. | Severance savings are EXCLUDED from the monthly withholding base but must still be reported here. They split THREE ways downstream - paid to the employee, deposited to the fund, and under the pre-1991 traditional regime - for Form 220 casillas 47-49 and Format 2276 numerals 18-20. Maintain the three buckets from the outset. |
| 25 | Meal payments (NIE153 / NIE154) | Payroll engine | Maintain the ET art. 387-1 split independently of the S / NS split: the amount UP TO 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) where salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940) goes to Format 2276 numeral 32, and the EXCESS goes to numeral 8. Both are still reported in the XML as PagoAlimentacionS or NS. | Two orthogonal splits apply to the same amount - salary / non-salary for the XML and contributions, and under-41-UVT / excess for the information return. Model them as two independent attributes, not one. |
| 26 | Incapacity (NIE123-NIE127) | Payroll engine | Emit one Incapacity element per episode with its dates, day count, type code and amount. For type 1 (comun) the employer bears days 1-2 and the EPS funds from day 3; for types 2 and 3 the ARL funds from day one at 100%. The employer ADVANCES the benefit and recovers it from the institution, so the amount here is what the employee received. | The first-two-days rate is a configuration constant, default 66.67% (CST art. 227: two-thirds of salary for the first 90 days); the primary source does not state the rate. The one-minimum-wage floor on incapacity pay follows settled practice and is a configuration constant of the incapacity calculation. |
| 27 | AltoRiesgoPension (NIE043) | Employee master data | Set true where the employee performs an activity listed in Decree-Law 2090 of 2003. The flag is always emitted (1-1); write the literal true or false, rather than 1 or 0. | The ADDITIONAL employer pension contribution for high-risk work - ten percentage points above the standard rate, borne by the employer (Decree-Law 2090 of 2003 art. 5; the Resolution 2388 rate table shows 26% total against the standard 16%) - and its base are held in the contribution-rate configuration table, maintained from the primary source in force for the year. |
| 28 | **═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══** |  |  |  |
| 29 | NIE014 / NIE015 and NIE051 / NIE052 | Engine (validation) | The five-digit municipality code must begin with the two-digit department code. Validate this for both the generation location and the place of work before transmission. | DIVIPOLA codes are re-used across departments in their last three digits; only the full five-digit code is unique. |
| 30 | NIE065 and NIE066 / NIE067 / NIE068 | Engine (validation) | Where the payment method is a bank-mediated medium (42, 45, 47 and 98; 48 and 49 only where the card is linked to a salary account), the bank, account type and account number must all be present. Where it is 10 (Efectivo), all three must be absent. | Colombia does NOT use IBAN. Account numbers are numeric, of bank-specific length, with no national check digit, so no structural validation is possible - only a bank-specific rule or pre-notification. |
| 31 | NIE199 and NIE204 | Engine (validation) | Where the Change event element is present, CUNENov is mandatory inside it; where Change event is absent, CUNENov must not appear. Bidirectional. | A Change event without a referenced CUNE breaks the cross-reference chain for the employment relationship. |
| 32 | NIAE214 and the Replace / Delete blocks | Engine (validation) | TipoNota = 1 requires the Replace block and forbids Delete; TipoNota = 2 requires Delete and forbids Replace. Mutually exclusive. | The Delete CUNE uses ValDev = ValDed = ValTol = 0.00 and DocEmp = 0 (Annex s.8.1.1.4). A shared CUNE routine that reads the real totals will produce a wrong hash for cancellations. |
| 33 | NIE041 and NIE042 and NIE164 | Engine (validation) | Where SubTipoTrabajador (NIE042) = 01 (employed old-age pensioner), the pension rate NIE164 must be 0.00 and no pension deduction may be emitted. | The PILA equivalent (subtipo 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 12 forces field 46 to zero) is broader; map, do not copy. |
| 34 | NIE157 and NIE061 and NIE041 | Engine (validation) | Where the apprentice maintenance support (NIE157) is populated, the contract type must be 4 (Aprendizaje) and the worker type must be 12 or 19. | Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21 made the apprenticeship a labour contract from 2026, so an apprentice now also generates a full PILA settlement - not only the support payment. |
| 35 | Cross-report reconciliation | Engine (reconciliation) | Monthly: SUM(NIE177) over all employees must equal Form 350 casillas 93 plus 94 after the nearest-1,000 rounding. SUM(NIE163), SUM(NIE166) and SUM(NIE168 + NIE170) must equal the PILA totals for health, pension and the solidarity fund, allowing for PILA's round-up-to-100. Annually: the accumulation of each Earnings element must equal the corresponding Form 220 casilla and Format 2276 numeral. | Run the reconciliation BEFORE transmission. A mismatch discovered after validation can only be put right by an adjustment note, which consumes a new document number. |

The PILA figure for the same contribution is COP 480,000 rounded UP to the next 100, which happens to coincide here. |
| 36 | 4.00 / 480000.00 | FondoPension @Porcentaje / @Deduccion (NIE164 / NIE166) | Employee pension at 4% of COP 12,000,000. | The employer's 12% is a PILA cost, not a deduction. Total pension into the system is 16% = COP 1,920,000. |
| 37 | 0.50 / 60000.00 | FondoSP @Porcentaje / @DeduccionSP (NIE167 / NIE168) | Solidarity sub-account at 0.5% of COP 12,000,000 (50% of the additional 1%), because the base is at or above 4 SMMLV. | SEPARATE from pension. Merging this into FondoPension to show a 5% pension line is the single most common Colombian mapping error. |
| 38 | 0.50 / 60000.00 | FondoSP @PorcentajeSub / @DeduccionSub (NIE169 / NIE170) | Subsistence sub-account at 0.5% of COP 12,000,000 (the other 50% of the additional 1%); no band surcharge because the base is below 16 SMMLV. | Both sub-accounts start at 4 SMMLV; only the subsistence one rises from 16 SMMLV (Ley 100 art. 27 as amended by Ley 797 art. 8). |
| 39 | 617232.00 | RetencionFuente (NIE177) | Withholding computed under Procedure 1: gross 12,000,000 less non-constitutive contributions 1,080,000 = 10,920,000; less 25% exempt income 2,730,000 (within the 40% limit and the annual 790-UVT and 1,340-UVT caps, tracked year-to-date) = base 8,190,000; = 156.375 UVT; band 150-360 UVT at 28%: (156.375 - 150) x 0.28 + 10 = 11.785 UVT; x 52,374 = COP 617,232. Not rounded in the payroll document: DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.11.11 requires approximation to the multiple of 1,000 only in tax-return forms and payment receipts (Form 350). | NON-RESIDENT CONTRAST: the same employee, before acquiring residence, would be withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS - 20% x 12,000,000 = COP 2,400,000, with no depuration and no exempt income. Nearly four times the resident figure. |
| 40 | 1697232.00 | DeduccionesTotal (NIE188) | 480,000 + 480,000 + 120,000 + 617,232. | Art. 5 item 7. CUNE input [5]. |
| 41 | **═══ TOTALS AND CONTROL ═══** |  |  |  |
| 42 | (absent) | Rounding (NIE186) | No residual: every concept is a whole peso, so the round-half-to-even sums tie exactly. | Where a residual arises it must be disclosed here, within the +/- 2.00 tolerance, not absorbed into a concept. |
| 43 | 10302768.00 | ComprobanteTotal (NIE189) | 12,000,000 - 1,697,232. | Art. 5 item 8. CUNE input [6]. This is the amount that must match the bank payment file. |
| 44 | NOT COMPUTED (illustrative) | CUNE (NIE024) | ILLUSTRATIVE VALUE - the CUNE in the Sample File is not computed. A real CUNE is SHA-384 over NE1042 + 2026-04-05 + <HoraGen> + 12000000.00 + 1697232.00 + 10302768.00 + 900123456 + 1020304050 + 102 + <PIN> + 1. | 96 hexadecimal characters. The PIN never appears in the XML. Any change to any of the eleven inputs yields a different document. |

### Sheet: Sample File

SAMPLE FILE - XML AND SOAP ENVELOPE - CONSTRUCTED FROM THE OFFICIAL ANEXO TECNICO XPATH INVENTORY  
PROVENANCE NOTE - READ FIRST  
════════════  
The SOAP envelopes below are QUOTED VERBATIM from the official Technical Annex  
version 1.0, sections 9.5 and 9.7.2.  
The XML instance below is CONSTRUCTED from the annex's own XPath inventory  
(sections 3 and 4, 195 NIE codes) and populated with the worked example on the  
Example Analysis sheet. DIAN publishes no sample instance in the annex, so this  
is a faithful reconstruction of the documented structure - NOT an official  
DIAN sample.  
Validate it against XSD v1.0.6 in the DIAN habilitacion environment before use.  
The ds:Signature block is shown as a stand-in; it is produced by the signing  
component, not by payroll.  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
1. TRANSMISSION - SOAP 1.2 request (Anexo Tecnico s.9.5 / s.9.7.2, verbatim)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope"  
xmlns:wcf="http://wcf.dian.colombia">  
<soap:Header/>  
<soap:Body>  
<wcf:SendNominaSync>  
<!--Optional:-->  
<wcf:contentFile>cid:1057568194758</wcf:contentFile>  
</wcf:SendNominaSync>  
</soap:Body>  
</soap:Envelope>  
wcf:contentFile carries the base64 encoding of a ZIP containing the XML below.  
Maximum 500 KB per XML document (rule ZA01). UTF-8 only. TLS 1.2 with mutual certificate authentication.  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
2. RESPONSE - SOAP 1.2 response header (Anexo Tecnico s.9.7.2, verbatim)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
<s:Envelope xmlns:s="http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope"  
xmlns:a="http://www.w3.org/2005/08/addressing"  
xmlns:u="http://docs.oasis-open.org/wss/2004/01/oasis-200401-wss-wssecurity-utility-1.0.xsd">  
<s:Header>  
<a:Action s:mustUnderstand="1">  
http://wcf.dian.colombia/IWcfDianCustomerServices/SendNominaSyncResponse  
</a:Action>  
</s:Header>  
...  
<!-- the body carries an ApplicationResponse encoded in Base64 with DIAN's  
validation verdict. THIS MUST BE PARSED AND PERSISTED - a payroll cost  
is deductible only where the document has been validated. -->  
</s:Envelope>

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
4. NON-RESIDENT VARIANT  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
The same document for a NON-RESIDENT employee differs in exactly one element -  
there is no residence attribute in the schema:  
<Deducciones>  
<Salud Porcentaje="4.00" Deduccion="480000.00"/>  
<FondoPension Porcentaje="4.00" Deduccion="480000.00"/>  
<FondoSP Porcentaje="0.50" DeduccionSP="60000.00" PorcentajeSub="0.50" DeduccionSub="60000.00"/>  
<RetencionFuente>2400000.00</RetencionFuente> <!-- ET art. 408: 20% x GROSS -->  
</Deducciones>  
<DevengadosTotal>12000000.00</DevengadosTotal>  
<DeduccionesTotal>3480000.00</DeduccionesTotal>  
<ComprobanteTotal>8520000.00</ComprobanteTotal>  
Flat 20% of ET art. 408 applied to the GROSS COP 12,000,000, with no art. 388  
depuration, no 25% exempt income, no art. 387 deductions and no tax-free band  
(DIAN Concepto 011108 of 29 June 2026). Where the work were performed ENTIRELY  
outside Colombia, LugarTrabajoPais would not be CO and there would be NO  
withholding at all (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019).  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
5. ADJUSTMENT NOTE SKELETON (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, TipoXML 103)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>  
<NominaIndividualDeAjuste>  
<TipoNota>1</TipoNota> <!-- 1 Reemplazar \| 2 Eliminar -->  
<Reemplazar>  
<!-- the ENTIRE NominaIndividual structure repeated with the correct values,  
under NIAE-prefixed codes, carrying its OWN CUNE computed on the same  
eleven inputs taken from this Reemplazar block -->  
</Reemplazar>  
</NominaIndividualDeAjuste>  
For TipoNota = 2 the Delete block is used instead, and its CUNE is computed  
with ValDev = ValDed = ValTol = 0.00 and DocEmp = 0 (Annex s.8.1.1.4). A shared  
CUNE routine that reads the real totals will produce a wrong hash for a  
cancellation - this is a deliberate divergence in the specification, not an  
error in it.

### Sheet: Report Matrix

MONTHLY WITHHOLDING TAX RETURN - FORM 350 — REPORT MATRIX  

| Row | Report ID | CO-DIAN-002 |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Report Name (EN) | Monthly Withholding Tax Return - Form 350 |
| 5 | Report Name (Local) | Formulario 350 - Declaracion de retenciones en la fuente |
| 6 | Document ID | CO-DIAN-002 |
| 7 | Document Title | Monthly Withholding Tax Return - Form 350 - Field Specification |
| 8 | Country | Colombia |
| 9 | Authority | National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN) |
| 10 | Report Type | Statutory monthly tax return |
| 11 | Tax Type | Income-tax withholding at source (retencion en la fuente) |
| 12 | Relationship | Employer (withholding agent) to DIAN |
| 13 | Frequency | Monthly. NOT required for a period with no withholding-subject operation (ET art. 606 par. 2) |
| 14 | Submission Deadline | 7th-16th BUSINESS DAY of the month following the period, by the LAST DIGIT of the employer NIT (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.33) |
| 15 | File Format | Portal-generated return: the casilla values are keyed, or robotically entered, into the DIAN Muisca online form. There is no standalone upload file format. |
| 16 | File Extension | N/A -- prepared and filed directly in the DIAN portal (Muisca) |
| 17 | Character Encoding | N/A |
| 18 | Record Types / Sections | Two sheets: sheet 1 (casillas 1-140 and 980-997, the return) and sheet 2 (casillas 141-155, the annex of payments abroad). The logical model is in the File Structure sheet. |
| 19 | Version | v1.1 |
| 22 | DETAILED COMPLIANCE NOTES (Colombia-specific) |  |
| 23 | SUBMISSION CHANNEL |  |
| 24 | - Channel: online_form \| Portal: DIAN Electronic Computer Services (Muisca), www.dian.gov.co \| Source: DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 para. 1 and the form's own instruction guide, which repeatedly refers to 'el SI de Diligenciamiento' computing casillas automatically. |  |
| 25 | - This is a PORTAL ROUND-TRIP, not machine-to-machine. Do not model it on the electronic payroll: DIAN publishes no XSD, no cahier des charges and no import template for Form 350. The engine's deliverable is a reconciled casilla-value set, not a file. |  |
| 26 | - The DIAN service computes several casillas itself - 55, 56, 57, 58, 109, 110, 111, 112 from the sheet-2 annex; 130, 134, 136 and 138 as totals; 147 as 145 x 146; and 28 from 27. Payroll must not attempt to supply those. |  |
| 27 | - Signature is by the Electronic Signature Instrument (IFE) authorised by DIAN - an authenticated portal credential, not an X.509 document signature as in the electronic payroll. |  |
| 28 | - The tax portal is NOT the social-security channel. PILA is filed through a licensed private information operator and never touches Muisca. |  |
| 29 | INTEGRATION TYPE AND DIRECTION |  |
| 30 | - Integration: outbound only - the engine delivers the reconciled casilla-value set to the DIAN portal. There is no inbound file: the portal returns an on-screen acknowledgement and a form number (casilla 4), which the engine should capture for the audit trail and for any later corrective return (casilla 26). |  |
| 31 | - Product mapping is required: the engine must accumulate withholding BY COUNTERPARTY TYPE - natural person versus legal person - and, within natural persons, must separate resident employment income (casillas 77 / 93) from payments to non-residents (the sheet-2 annex). The 2024 redesign introduced that separation; the pre-2024 form did not have it. |  |
| 32 | - Payroll owns six casillas directly - 77 and 93 for resident employees, 78 and 94 for the pensions the employer pays itself, and, for non-residents, the sheet-2 rows that roll into 109 / 111 or 110 / 112 - plus casilla 129 where a prior over-withholding is reversed. Everything else on the form comes from accounts payable or the tax function. |  |
| 33 | RESIDENT / NON-RESIDENT TREATMENT |  |
| 34 | - RESIDENT employees are reported on SHEET 1: the depurated ET art. 388 base in casilla 77 and the withholding under the art. 383 progressive table in casilla 93. |  |
| 35 | - NON-RESIDENT foreign natural persons are reported in the 'Pagos al exterior' section: SHEET 2 rows carrying the sheet-2 payment concept and the DIAN country-table code, rolling up to casillas 109 / 111 (no treaty) or 110 / 112 (treaty). The base in casilla 145 is the NOMINAL (gross) payment, because ET art. 408 admits no depuration, and the rate in casilla 146 is 20%. They are excluded from casillas 77 / 93. |  |
| 36 | - The sheet-2 concepto de pago (casilla 142) for a non-resident employee is concept 5, 'Prestaciones de servicios y compensacion por servicios personales', for a non-treaty country, and concept 24, 'Rentas de trabajo', for a treaty country. Concept 24's own definition on the form is 'rentas de trabajo de cualquier naturaleza EN RELACION CON UN EMPLEO a favor de personas naturales no residentes' - it is unambiguously the employee concept. |  |
| 37 | - The same employee therefore MOVES BETWEEN SHEETS during the year when residence is acquired: sheet 2 while non-resident, sheet 1 from the payment following the date the 183-day test is met. The switch is prospective only; the earlier months are not restated (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). |  |
| 38 | - Directors' fees to a non-resident go to concept 25 (Honorarios de directores) and employer-paid pensions to concept 27 (Pensiones) - neither is the employee concept, and mis-selecting them changes the treaty article applied. |  |
| 39 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 40 | - Casilla 93 plus casilla 94 must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month - CO-DIAN-001 - after the nearest-1,000 rounding. The contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 / 126-4 is practised by the fund and is in neither casilla; the theoretical and hypothetical wage types (21114, 21619, 25834) are out of scope; wage type 21330 is included only where it carries the withholding actually deducted. |  |
| 41 | - Casilla 27 (art. 114-1 exonerated self-withholder) rests on the SAME exoneration test as PILA file tipo 1 field 33 and Record Tipo 2 field 76 - CO-PILA-003. |  |
| 42 | - The twelve monthly casilla-93 figures do NOT produce Form 220. Colombia imposes no employer year-end reconciliation; Form 220 (CO-DIAN-004) is a SEPARATE per-employee obligation built from the annual accumulation, not from the monthly returns. |  |
| 43 | - Casilla 77 is an AGGREGATE base; the per-employee detail behind it is reported annually in Format 2276 (CO-DIAN-005), which is why the two cannot be derived from one another. |  |
| 44 | - Form 350 aggregates every withholding the employer makes, including on supplier payments and VAT. Payroll is one contributor among several; the return is owned by the employer's tax function. |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - MONTHLY WITHHOLDING TAX RETURN - FORM 350  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHICH payments and employees are subject to Form 350 withholding and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Indefinite-term employee (indefinite-term contract) | YES | The core private-sector population. CST art. 47; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 5. |
| 7 | Fixed-term employee (fixed-term contract, max 4 years) | YES | Identical reporting treatment to an indefinite-term contract. CST art. 46; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6. |
| 8 | Specific-work or task employee (contract por obra o labor) | YES | An employment contract; CST art. 46. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 3 (Obra o Labor). |
| 9 | Occasional / accidental / transitory worker (< 1 month, non-core activity) | YES | Still an employee under CST art. 6. Reported on every filing; the PILA return type and the day counts differ, not the obligation. |
| 10 | Part-time employee | YES | Colombia has no separate part-time regime. Reported normally; the PILA contribution base is floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) except for the worker type 51 partial-time regime. |
| 11 | All-inclusive salary employee (all-inclusive salary, >= 13 SMMLV) | YES | CST art. 132 num. 2. Reported with the integral-salary flag set; the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, and the electronic payroll carries SalarioIntegral = true. |
| 12 | Apprentice (apprenticeship contract) | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19). |
| 13 | Intern / practical placement (practicas o pasantias) | YES | Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 5. Reported where remunerated. |
| 14 | Teleworkers and remote workers | YES | Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158). |
| 15 | Resident foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | Full reporting. Withheld under the ET art. 383 progressive table once tax residence is acquired. |
| 16 | NON-RESIDENT foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Reported in the 'Pagos al exterior' section - sheet-2 rows with the sheet-2 payment concept and the DIAN country-table code - and excluded from casillas 77 / 93: withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the NOMINAL (gross) value, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix. |
| 17 | Employed old-age pensioner in active service | YES | PILA worker sub-type 01; no pension contribution (PILA pension rate field = 0), health and the levies still apply. |
| 18 | Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract | YES | Reported as an ordinary employee where an employment contract exists. |
| 19 | Independent contractor (service contract) | NO | Not an employee. The contractor self-files PILA on 40% of fees (return types I / Y, descoped) and is reported by the payer in the third-party information return, not in this employer filing. Withholding on their fees does pass through Form 350, but under a different casilla. |
| 20 | Public-sector employee (contributor type 47, SGP-funded entity) | NO | Public-sector employees are outside the scope of this specification; the public-sector PILA return types T and F are not produced. |
| 21 | Non-executive director paid fees only (junta directiva) | NO | Not an employee where no employment contract exists: directors' fees are not employment income and are not produced by payroll. The withholding on them is declared by the employer's accounts-payable or tax function - in the natural-person fees casillas (79 / 95, or 77 / 93 where the fee is withheld under the ET art. 383 table, art. 383 para. 2) for a resident director and under sheet-2 concept 25 (Honorarios de directores) for a non-resident director - never as payroll employment income. A director holding an employment contract is reported as an ordinary employee (see 'Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract'). |
| 22 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by a fund, not by the employer | NO | The paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. |
| 23 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 24 | Depurated taxable base of resident employees | YES | Casilla 77. The ET art. 388 base after non-constitutive income, art. 387 deductions and the 25% exempt income - NOT the gross. |
| 25 | Withholding on resident employees | YES | Casilla 93. The art. 383 progressive table result, approximated to the nearest 1,000. |
| 26 | Gross payments to non-resident employees | YES | Sheet 2 casilla 145, rolling up to casilla 109 or 110. The NOMINAL (gross) value, because art. 408 admits no depuration. Excluded from casilla 77. |
| 27 | Withholding on non-resident employees | YES | Sheet 2 casilla 147, rolling up to casilla 111 or 112. The flat 20% of art. 408, or the treaty rate. |
| 28 | Employer-paid pension income above 1,000 UVT | YES | Casillas 78 / 94, where the employer itself pays pensions (the retirees' pay group): the taxable excess over 1,000 UVT in 78 and the withholding actually practised on it (WT 21140, WT 21155) in 94 - never in 77 / 93. Casilla 93 plus casilla 94 reconcile to the electronic payroll RetencionFuente. |
| 29 | Reversal of excess or undue withholding | YES | Casilla 129, where an employee's withholding is adjusted downward in a later month. |
| 30 | Employer social-security contributions | NO | Not a withholding. Reported on PILA. Form 350 is a TAX return only. |
| 31 | Employee social-security contributions | NO | Not a withholding by the employer in the ET sense. They reduce the casilla-77 base as non-constitutive income, but are never declared as a retencion. |
| 32 | Payments in the 0% band of the art. 383 table | PARTIAL | The payment IS included in the casilla-77 base; the withholding in casilla 93 is simply nil for that employee. Do not exclude the base. |
| 33 | Withholding on supplier and contractor payments | NO | Casillas 29-54 (legal persons) and 79-108 (natural persons). Not produced by payroll: populated by the employer's accounts-payable or tax function. Form 350 aggregates every withholding the employer makes; payroll contributes only casillas 77 / 93, casillas 78 / 94 where the employer pays pensions itself, the sheet-2 rows for non-resident employees and casilla 129 where a prior over-withholding is reversed. |
| 34 | VAT and stamp-duty withholding | NO | Casillas 131-135. Owned by the employer's tax function. |
| 35 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 36 | Reported on the accrual (causacion) date | NO | Every Colombian payroll filing is keyed to the PAYMENT or credit-in-account date, not to the accrual date. A December salary paid in January falls in the January filing. |
| 37 | Reported on the payment or credit-in-account date | YES | The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276. |
| 38 | A semi-monthly payroll produces two filings a month | NO | It does not. The electronic payroll is expressly ONE monthly document per employee 'irrespective of whether the obliged party makes payments in different or shorter periods' (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2). PILA and Form 350 are likewise monthly. |
| 39 | Nil period still filed | NO | A period with no operation subject to withholding is not filed: ET art. 606 para. 2 makes the return non-obligatory for such a period (Population Rules, 'Nil period'). The electronic payroll and PILA have no equivalent exemption, so a month with employees but no withholding still produces those two filings and no Form 350. |
| 40 | Corrections handled by re-filing the whole period | VARIES | Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8). |
| 41 | **═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══** |  |  |
| 42 | A month in which no withholding was practised | NO | ET art. 606 para. 2: the return is NOT obligatory for a period with no operation subject to withholding. This is unusual among Colombian filings - the electronic payroll and PILA do not have an equivalent exemption. |
| 43 | Employee whose withholding is nil because the base is in the 0% band | YES | The BASE still goes in casilla 77. Only the withholding is nil. |
| 44 | Employee who acquires tax residence mid-year | YES | Reported on sheet 2 for the months before residence and on sheet 1 from the payment following the date the 183-day test is met. Prospective only - the earlier months are never restated. |
| 45 | Non-resident whose work is performed entirely outside Colombia | NO | Foreign-source income, not taxable in Colombia, no withholding and nothing to declare (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019). |
| 46 | Filing the return without paying it | NO | ET art. 580-1: a withholding return filed without full payment produces NO legal effect, with no administrative act required. Casilla 980 must equal casilla 138. |
| 47 | Correcting a filed return | YES | By a corrective return carrying casilla 25 (correction code) and casilla 26 (the form number being amended). The minimum penalty is 10 UVT of the year the ORIGINAL return was filed. |

The instruction guide defines it as 'los pagos gravables (base sujeta a retencion) efectuados a personas naturales por concepto de salarios, comisiones, prestaciones sociales, viaticos, gastos de representacion, honorarios, emolumentos eclesiasticos, compensaciones recibidas por el trabajo asociado cooperativo, pagos en especie, pagos en acciones y, en general, las compensaciones por servicios personales'. It is the DEPURATED taxable base of RESIDENT natural persons, not the gross: the ET art. 388 base after non-constitutive income, art. 387 deductions and the 25% exempt income - the base on which the casilla-93 withholding is computed. Non-resident foreign natural persons are NOT in this casilla: their payments are reported in the 'Pagos al exterior' section as sheet-2 rows (casillas 141-146) with the sheet-2 payment concept and country, at the nominal (gross) value, at the 20% rate of ET art. 408 and with no depuration; the employee's tax-residence flag decides the section. Pension income paid by the employer is not in this casilla either: it goes to casilla 78. Note also that the casilla sweeps in fees paid to natural persons under the art. 383 table, which are not employment income - payroll supplies only the employment component. Accumulated by the payment date of each run (payment or credit to account, whichever comes first), not by the pay period the run settles - the same timing rule as casilla 93. | Y | - | Whole pesos per employee; round only the aggregated monthly casilla total to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return. | N | Amount | Monthly |  |  |
| 23 | Withholding - work income (natural persons) | Rentas de trabajo - retenciones a titulo de renta | Income-Tax Withholdings - Natural Persons | 93 | N | Y |  | Hoja 1, casilla 93 | 12 | N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000) | 617000 | SUM(Payroll.Income_Tax_Withheld) | THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to RESIDENT natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY pay group and EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month - regular, weekly or exceptional-advance, termination and settlement runs alike - in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577). Source: wage type 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus wage type 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' where it carries the withholding actually deducted from the employee's pay (the case in which the WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item). The amount is the withholding actually deducted from the employee's pay, computed with the employee's AFC and voluntary-pension contributions (ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4) taken into account; never the figure computed without those contributions. Contingent withholding (ET arts. 126-1 / 126-4) - the difference between the withholding computed without and with those contributions - is practised by the AFC or voluntary-pension fund when the savings are withdrawn before the permanence requirement is met; it is not practised by the employer and does not enter this return, and the wage types that carry a theoretical or hypothetical amount never deducted - 21114 'Theoretical income Tax-5011', 21619 'Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035' and 25834 'Hypothetical Witholding Tax - IC Foreign Country' - are out of scope: a theoretical or hypothetical amount is not withholding actually practised. WT 2552 withholding deducted in advance runs (WT 61100 'Weekly advance', WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance') and in termination or settlement runs (WT 62116, 62110, 62203, 62115) enters in the month it is practised, whatever the run. Withholding deducted on WT 21129 (Terminations) enters in the month it is practised, and so does the withholding on WT 25832 (Stock awards vesting) and 25833 (IC Local Country) where the WTC classifies them as withholding actually deducted from the employee. Whether a wage type carries withholding actually practised, and therefore feeds casilla 93, follows from the withholding classification of each wage type, which comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) attribute. Withholding on the pension income the employer pays itself (WT 21140 'Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799', WT 21155 'Income Tax Pensioner') is not reported here: it goes to casilla 94, with its base in casilla 78. Withholding at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on a NON-RESIDENT foreign natural person is not reported here: it is supplied as sheet-2 rows (casillas 141-146) in the 'Pagos al exterior' section, with the sheet-2 payment concept and country, on the nominal (gross) value and with no depuration, and rolls into casillas 111 / 112; the employee's tax-residence flag, not the withholding rate or the tax-procedure code, decides the section. Accumulate by the payroll engine's run key (pay group and run), not by a report-level identifier. Casilla 93 plus casilla 94 must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130. TIMING: the withholding is practised, and therefore declared, in the month of the payment or of the credit to the employee's account, whichever comes first, never by the pay period the run settles - a run whose period ends in one month and that is paid in the next is declared in the month of payment, and a run paid on the last day of a month belongs to that month (ET art. 383: withholding on the payments made; ET art. 27: the income of a natural person is realised when it is received; instruction guide of Res. DIAN 000031/2024: the return declares the withholding practised in the month). Accumulate the runs by their payment date, not by their period. | Y | - | Whole pesos per employee; round only the aggregated monthly casilla total to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return. | N | Amount | Monthly |  |  |

### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ SUBMISSION FORMAT ═══  

| Row | Channel | online_form. Data is keyed, or robotically entered, directly into the DIAN Electronic Computer Services (Muisca) form at www.dian.gov.co. |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Why this is NOT XML | DIAN publishes NO XSD, NO cahier des charges and NO import template for Form 350. DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 para. 1 says only that filers must use 'los Servicios Informaticos dispuestos por la entidad, utilizando el Instrumento de Firma Electronica (IFE)', and that DIAN 'pondra a disposicion el Formulario numero 350 en forma virtual en la pagina web'. Contrast the electronic payroll, which has a published XSD and a SOAP contract. |
| 5 | Authentication | Electronic Signature Instrument (IFE) authorised by DIAN - an authenticated portal credential. NOT an X.509 document signature. |
| 6 | Consequence for the model below | The structure below is a LOGICAL MODEL - the field list and hierarchy of the return - NOT the wire or submission format. There is no wire format to document. |
| 7 | Payment | The return must be paid IN FULL. ET art. 580-1: a withholding return filed without full payment produces no legal effect, with no administrative act needed to declare it so. Casilla 980 must equal casilla 138. |
| 8 | **═══ LOGICAL MODEL - SHEET 1 (CASILLAS 1 TO 140, PLUS 980-997) ═══** |  |

| 10 | Block 2 - Correction | 25 Cod. correction \| 26 Numero de formulario anterior. Both blank on an initial return; both populated on a corrective one. |
| 11 | Block 3 - Autorretencion art. 114-1 | 27 Economic activity principal (CIIU) \| 28 Rate (disabled from the June 2026 period; not populated) |
