### Sheet: Report Matrix

ANNUAL CERTIFICATE OF INCOME AND WITHHOLDING ON WORK AND PENSION INCOME - FORM 220 — REPORT MATRIX  

| Row | Report ID | CO-DIAN-004 |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Report Name (EN) | Annual Certificate of Income and Withholding on Work and Pension Income - Form 220 |
| 5 | Report Name (Local) | Formulario 220 - Certificado de ingresos y retenciones por rentas de trabajo y de pensiones |
| 6 | Document ID | CO-DIAN-004 |
| 7 | Document Title | Annual Certificate of Income and Withholding - Form 220 - Field Specification |
| 8 | Country | Colombia |
| 9 | Authority | DIAN prescribes the form; the EMPLOYER issues it to each employee and retains it -- NOT filed with DIAN |
| 10 | Report Type | Statutory annual employee certificate (not a return) |
| 11 | Tax Type | Income-tax withholding certification |
| 12 | Relationship | Employer to employee (issued and retained, not submitted to DIAN) |
| 13 | Frequency | Annual, one certificate per employee per tax year |
| 14 | Submission Deadline | Last business day of March following the fiscal year (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.40) |
| 15 | File Format | Paper or electronic, as agreed with the employee |
| 16 | File Extension | N/A - nothing is transmitted; the certificate is delivered on paper or electronically as agreed with the employee |
| 17 | Character Encoding | N/A |
| 18 | Record Types / Sections | No record types - a logical model of casillas grouped in the form's sections (see File Structure) |
| 19 | Version | v1.3 |
| 22 | DETAILED COMPLIANCE NOTES (Colombia-specific) |  |
| 23 | SUBMISSION CHANNEL |  |
| 24 | - Channel: paper or electronic delivery TO THE EMPLOYEE \| Portal: none - this artefact is NOT submitted to any authority \| Source: ET arts. 378-380 and the form's own instruction guide, which addresses only the issuing of the certificate. |  |
| 25 | - This is the one in-scope Colombian artefact with NO government channel at all. It is issued to the employee and retained by the employer. DIAN sees the same data annually through Format 2276 (CO-DIAN-005), which IS filed - but the two are separate obligations with different field sets and different deadlines. |  |
| 26 | - The certificate SUBSTITUTES for the employee's income-tax return where the six ET art. 380 conditions hold (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.7), which is why it carries employee-declared sections that payroll cannot populate. |  |
| 27 | INTEGRATION TYPE AND DIRECTION |  |
| 28 | - Integration: outbound only, to the EMPLOYEE rather than to an authority. There is no inbound leg. |  |
| 29 | - product_mapping_required = true. The certificate needs per-employee ANNUAL totals by concept, three separate severance buckets, the meal-payment split at 41 UVT, the rolling six-month average labour income, and the AVC deduction which has no dedicated electronic payroll element. None of these can be reconstructed at year end from a single annual gross figure. |  |
| 30 | - NOT DERIVABLE FROM THE MONTHLY FILINGS. Colombia imposes NO employer year-end tax reconciliation. This certificate is a SEPARATE annual obligation built from the annual accumulation, and it additionally carries data the employer never sees monthly - the employee's own asset, debt and other-income declarations under ET art. 380. |  |
| 31 | RESIDENT / NON-RESIDENT TREATMENT |  |
| 32 | - RESIDENT: casilla 60 carries the ET art. 383 progressive-table withholding for the year, and casillas 53 to 58 carry the contributions and voluntary savings that depurated the base. The employee may then use the certificate in place of a return under ET art. 380. |  |
| 33 | - NON-RESIDENT: the same certificate is issued, but casilla 60 carries the FLAT 20% of ET art. 408 applied to the GROSS - so casilla 52 (total gross income) and the withholding in casilla 60 stand in a simple 20% relationship, with NO depuration visible. The contributions in casillas 53 and 54 are still reported because they were still deducted, but they did NOT reduce the withholding base. |  |
| 34 | - Severance savings and their interest (casillas 47 to 49) are never withheld, for residents and non-residents alike (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3, extended to every payer by Corte Constitucional C-397 de 1994; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11), so the six-month average of casilla 59 has no effect on casilla 60. For a non-resident it is reported for completeness; the art. 206 num. 4 exemption is applied, if at all, in the employee's own return (DIAN Concepto 577 de 2020: a non-resident who must file applies ET art. 26 together with arts. 178 and 235-2, which keeps the art. 206 exemptions). |  |
| 35 | - An employee who ACQUIRES RESIDENCE mid-year receives ONE certificate covering the whole period, with casilla 60 carrying the sum of the 20% months and the art. 383 months. The certificate does not disclose the split; the employee reconciles on their own return. The engine should retain the split internally for audit. |  |
| 36 | - The employee's own annual return - Form 110 - is outside the scope of this specification: the employer's duty ends with this certificate. |  |
| 37 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 38 | - Casilla 60 must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll RetencionFuente (NIE177) for this employee - CO-DIAN-001. |  |
| 39 | - Casillas 53 and 54 must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE163 and NIE166 + NIE168 + NIE170, and to the employee portions of PILA campos 55, 47, 51 and 52 - CO-PILA-003. |  |
| 40 | - The SUM of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casillas 93 plus 94 - CO-DIAN-002 - but the certificate is NOT derived from those returns. |  |
| 41 | - Casillas 36 to 60 map almost one for one to Format 2276 numerals 5 to 33 - CO-DIAN-005 - but the ORDER OF THE THREE SEVERANCE LINES DIFFERS: Form 220 runs 47 paid / 48 traditional / 49 fund, while Format 2276 runs 18 paid / 19 fund / 20 traditional. A positional copy between the two SWAPS the fund and traditional amounts. |  |
| 42 | - Casilla 49 must reconcile to the amount actually deposited under CO-CESANTIAS-006 by 14 February OF THE TAX YEAR: the February deposit is certified in the year of the deposit (ET art. 27 num. 3). |  |
| 43 | - Casillas 79 to 82 (dependants) map to Format 2276 numeral 34. |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - ANNUAL CERTIFICATE OF INCOME AND WITHHOLDING ON WORK AND PENSION INCOME - FORM 220  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHO receives a Form 220 certificate and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Indefinite-term employee (indefinite-term contract) | YES | The core private-sector population. CST art. 47; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 5. |
| 7 | Fixed-term employee (fixed-term contract, max 4 years) | YES | Identical reporting treatment to an indefinite-term contract. CST art. 46; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6. |
| 8 | Specific-work or task employee (contract por obra o labor) | YES | An employment contract; CST art. 46. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 3 (Obra o Labor). |
| 9 | Occasional / accidental / transitory worker (< 1 month, non-core activity) | YES | Still an employee under CST art. 6. Reported on every filing; the PILA return type and the day counts differ, not the obligation. |
| 10 | Part-time employee | YES | Colombia has no separate part-time regime. Reported normally; the PILA contribution base is floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) except for the worker type 51 partial-time regime. |
| 11 | All-inclusive salary employee (all-inclusive salary, >= 13 SMMLV) | YES | CST art. 132 num. 2. Reported with the integral-salary flag set; the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, and the electronic payroll carries SalarioIntegral = true. |
| 12 | Apprentice (apprenticeship contract) | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19). |
| 13 | Intern / practical placement (practicas o pasantias) | YES | Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 5. Reported where remunerated. |
| 14 | Teleworkers and remote workers | YES | Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158). |
| 15 | Resident foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | Full reporting. Withheld under the ET art. 383 progressive table once tax residence is acquired. |
| 16 | NON-RESIDENT foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix. |
| 17 | Employed old-age pensioner in active service | YES | PILA worker sub-type 01; no pension contribution (PILA pension rate field = 0), health and the levies still apply. |
| 18 | Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract | YES | Reported as an ordinary employee where an employment contract exists. |
| 19 | Independent contractor (service contract) | NO | Not an employee. The contractor self-files PILA on 40% of fees (return types I / Y, descoped) and is reported by the payer in the third-party information return, not in this employer filing. Withholding on their fees does pass through Form 350, but under a different casilla. |
| 20 | Public-sector employee (contributor type 47, SGP-funded entity) | NO | Public-sector only; PILA return types T and F are outside the scope of this specification. |
| 21 | Non-executive director paid fees only (junta directiva) | NO | Not an employee and not paid through payroll. Board fees (honorarios de junta directiva) are not payroll income: they are reported by the tax function outside payroll, as for an independent contractor. The withholding on them passes through Form 350, under a casilla other than the salary casilla. |
| 22 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by a fund, not by the employer | NO | The paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. A pension the employer pays directly is certified by the employer on this form, in casilla 50 'Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez' (see casilla 50); the pensioner's contributions on that pension are reported on the pensioners' PILA under Anexo Tecnico 3 (CO-PILA-007). |
| 23 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 24 | Annual salary paid | YES | Casilla 36, on the CST art. 127 definition quoted in full in the instruction guide. |
| 25 | Voucher, cheque, card and vale payments | YES | Casilla 37, including meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month. |
| 26 | Meal payments up to 41 UVT for an employee earning up to 310 UVT | NO | Not income of the employee at all under ET art. 387-1 - income of the food supplier. Only the EXCESS over 41 UVT is reported, in casilla 38. |
| 27 | Statutory benefits other than severance | YES | Casilla 42 - service bonus, vacaciones, work clothing. |
| 28 | Severance savings, split three ways | YES | Casillas 47 (paid to the employee), 48 (traditional pre-1991 regime) and 49 (deposited to the fund in the tax year; the February deposit is certified in the year of the deposit, ET art. 27 num. 3). Three separate buckets that must be maintained year-round. |
| 29 | Per diems and representation expenses | YES | Casillas 43 and 44. |
| 30 | Employee mandatory contributions | YES | Casillas 53 and 54. Note that pension and the solidarity fund are COMBINED in casilla 54, unlike the electronic payroll which separates them. |
| 31 | Voluntary savings - RAIS, voluntary pension, AFC, AVC | YES | Casillas 55 to 58, each separately. The electronic payroll has one element for the first two and none for AVC, so the engine must tag them itself. |
| 32 | Rolling six-month average labour income | YES | Casilla 59: the monthly average salary of six months, with the window set by the event - on termination or withdrawal, the last six months; while the employment continues, the six months of the preceding year at the time of the deposit (ET art. 206 num. 4; DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025; see casilla 59). Drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper; the salary history must be maintained year-round. |
| 33 | Employer social-security contributions | NO | Not certified. The form carries the employee's income (casillas 36 to 51) and the employee's own mandatory and voluntary contributions (casillas 53 to 58; instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). The employer's share of health, pension, ARL and parafiscal contributions is neither income of the employee nor a deduction from it and has no casilla on the form; it is reported in PILA (CO-PILA-003). |
| 34 | The employee's other income, assets and debts | NO | Casillas 61 to 78 are supplied BY THE EMPLOYEE, not by payroll. They exist so the certificate can substitute for the income-tax return under ET art. 380. |
| 35 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 36 | Reported on the accrual (causacion) date | NO | Every Colombian payroll filing is keyed to the PAYMENT or credit-in-account date, not to the accrual date. A December salary paid in January falls in the January filing. |
| 37 | Reported on the payment or credit-in-account date | YES | The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276. |
| 38 | A semi-monthly payroll produces two filings a month | NO | It does not. The electronic payroll is expressly ONE monthly document per employee 'irrespective of whether the obliged party makes payments in different or shorter periods' (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2). PILA and Form 350 are likewise monthly. |
| 39 | Nil period still filed | N/A | Form 220 is an annual certificate, not a periodic return, so there is no nil period. One certificate per employee per tax year is issued by the last business day of March following the tax year (DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.40) whether or not any withholding was practised; casilla 60 is written as zero where nil (see 'Employee whose withholding was nil all year'). |
| 40 | Corrections handled by re-filing the whole period | VARIES | Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8). |
| 41 | **═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══** |  |  |
| 42 | Employee who left during the year | YES | Casillas 30 and 31 carry the actual employment window rather than 1 January to 31 December. The certificate is still issued by the last business day of March. |
| 43 | Employee whose withholding was nil all year | YES | A certificate is still issued. Casilla 60 is ZERO - the instruction guide directs that a casilla with no value be written as zero, not left blank. |
| 44 | Employee who acquired tax residence mid-year | YES | ONE certificate for the whole period. Casilla 60 sums the 20% months and the art. 383 months; the split is not disclosed on the form but must be retained internally. |
| 45 | Employee with a dependant claimed for the art. 387 deduction | YES | Casillas 79 to 82 identify the dependant. The same dependant is reported in Format 2276 numeral 34, where DIAN matches a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer. |
| 46 | Employee under the pre-1991 traditional severance regime | YES | Casilla 48 rather than casilla 49. A shrinking population - employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. |
| 47 | Employee holding a PEP or PPT | YES | Reported with the admitted document held: 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria or 41 Pasaporte, the document types of the form's six-value list that a foreign national holds. A PEP or PPT is not a document type of the form and is not certified under any other code (see casilla 24). |
| 48 | Certificate substituting for the employee's income-tax return | YES | Where all six ET art. 380 conditions hold and the employee signs, the form states that it substitutes 'para todos los efectos legales' for the return. |

The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. BONUSES: HABITUAL bonuses are salary and are certified here - 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus and 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA; NON-HABITUAL bonuses are certified in casilla 46 - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is certified here where habitual and in casilla 46 where not; the habitual attribute of that bonus wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). PAYMENTS IN KIND: an in-kind payment that is salary under CST art. 127 is certified here and an in-kind payment that is not salary is certified in casilla 46; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the WTC (meal payments follow the 310 / 41 UVT test of casillas 37-38). LEAVE PAYOUTS 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts) and SALARY PAID ABROAD to expatriates (25830 / 65820 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) follow the same rule as every other earning: certified here where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary and in casilla 46 where it classifies it as non-salary work income. The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus), which is certified in casilla 42, and on per diems (62805-62808), which are always certified in casilla 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419; and it is absent from the bonus wage types 62229, 62224 and 62202 listed above. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, maintained as a configuration table from the WTC attributes; every earning wage type is assigned. THE ENGINE MUST MAINTAIN THIS AVERAGE YEAR-ROUND - it cannot be reconstructed at year end from annual totals because it is a moving six-month window, and on a termination it is the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT. HOW THE AVERAGE IS TAKEN: the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months - on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025). | Y | -> Sheet 6: Umbrales UVT 2026 | Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instruction guide directs. ### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ SUBMISSION FORMAT ═══  

| Row | Channel | Issued TO THE EMPLOYEE, on paper or electronically as agreed, and RETAINED BY THE EMPLOYER. There is NO government channel: Form 220 is a certificate, not a return, and is not submitted to DIAN. |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Source | ET arts. 378, 379 and 380; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.40 (deadline) and art. 1.6.1.13.2.7 (substitution for the income-tax return); the form's own instruction guide, which addresses only issuing. |
| 5 | Why there is no file format | DIAN prescribes the FORM but not a transmission format, because nothing is transmitted. The structure below is therefore a LOGICAL MODEL - the casilla list and its hierarchy - not a wire format. |
| 6 | Where DIAN does see this data | Annually, through Format 2276 (CO-DIAN-005), which IS filed. The two obligations overlap in content but differ in field set, ordering and deadline, and neither is derived from the other. |
| 7 | Retention | The employer retains the issued certificate as proof of the withholding. Where the employee signs the six ET art. 380 declarations, the certificate substitutes for their income-tax return, so its probative value runs beyond the employer. |
| 8 | **═══ LOGICAL MODEL - SECTIONS AND CASILLAS ═══** |  |

| 21 | Casilla 52 | Sume 36 a 51 - sixteen income casillas. |

| 25 | **═══ AMOUNT AND ROUNDING CONVENTION ═══** |  |
| 26 | Rounding | The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) is explicit: values 'deben ser expresados en pesos colombianos y aproximados al multiplo de mil (1.000) mas cercano'. The SAME convention as Form 350, and NOT the electronic payroll convention of two decimals round-half-to-even. |
| 27 | Nil values | The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) directs: 'En el evento en que no haya valor a registrar en alguna casilla escriba cero (0)'. Write ZERO, do not leave blank. This differs from the electronic payroll, where an inapplicable element is OMITTED rather than zero-filled. |
| 28 | RUT consistency | The instruction guide repeats for casillas 7 to 11 that where the value does not match the RUT, THE RUT MUST BE UPDATED BEFORE THE CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED. The certificate does not override the register. |
| 29 | **═══ THE THREE SEVERANCE LINES - AND THE ORDERING TRAP ═══** |  |
| 30 | Form 220 | 47 = paid to the employee \| 48 = traditional pre-1991 CST regime \| 49 = deposited to the fund |
| 31 | Format 2276 | 18 = paid to the employee \| 19 = deposited to the fund \| 20 = traditional pre-1991 CST regime |
| 32 | The trap | THE SECOND AND THIRD LINES ARE TRANSPOSED BETWEEN THE TWO ARTEFACTS. An implementation that maps positionally - 47 to 18, 48 to 19, 49 to 20 - will swap the fund deposit and the traditional-regime amount in the information return. Map by MEANING, never by position. |
| 33 | Recorded defect | The instruction guide for casilla 42 cross-refers severance deposited to the fund to 'la casilla 48'. The form's own printed label puts the fund deposit at casilla 49 and the traditional regime at casilla 48. The form layout is authoritative; the cross-reference is wrong. |

### Sheet: Population Rules

POPULATION RULES - HOW TO FILL EACH FIELD FROM PAYROLL  

| Row | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | **═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 4 | Casilla 4 - Numero de formulario | Engine sequence | Assign the certificate number from the ENGINE's own series - the instruction guide says it is 'asignado por la natural person o juridica que expide la certificacion'. Keep the series stable and unique per employee per tax year, because the employee may quote it when filing or when asking for a duplicate. The number is alphanumeric: DIAN prescribes no format for it (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). | SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORM 350, where casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned. Do not reuse the Form 350 numbering logic here. |
| 5 | Casillas 30 and 31 - Periodo de la certificacion | Payroll engine | Set casilla 30 to 1 January or the hire date, whichever is later, and casilla 31 to 31 December or the termination date, whichever is earlier. Write year, month, day in that order, as the instruction guide directs. | A leaver certificate covers only the employment window. It is still due by the last business day of March following the tax year, not on termination. |
| 6 | Casilla 36 - Salary payments | Payroll engine | Accumulate salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period, on the CST art. 127 definition the instruction guide quotes in full - ordinary fixed or variable remuneration plus everything received in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service: primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. Then apply the exclusion rule: remove anything belonging in casillas 38 to 46. | The exclusion rule is the trap. Commissions under an employment contract are salary and stay in casilla 36; commissions outside an employment relationship go to casilla 41. Habitual bonuses are salary and stay in casilla 36; non-habitual bonuses go to casilla 46. Vacation pay goes to casilla 42. Per diems ALWAYS go to casilla 43, even where the permanent portion is salary for contribution purposes. The certificate's classification and the contribution base's classification are NOT the same. |
| 7 | Casillas 47, 48 and 49 - the three severance lines | Payroll engine | Maintain THREE separate severance buckets from the outset, not one: (47) amounts and interest ACTUALLY PAID to the employee, (48) amounts RECOGNISED under the pre-1991 traditional CST regime, and (49) amounts DEPOSITED to the fund in the tax year - the deposit made by 14 February is certified in the year of the deposit (ET art. 27 num. 3). Casillas 48 and 49 are mutually exclusive for the same employee, because an employee is in one regime or the other. | They CANNOT be split retrospectively out of a single annual severance savings figure. And when mapping to Format 2276, map by MEANING: 47 to numeral 18, 48 to numeral 20, 49 to numeral 19. The second and third lines are transposed between the two artefacts. |
| 8 | Casilla 59 - Ingreso laboral promedio de los ultimos seis meses anteriores (numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.) | Payroll engine | Maintain the monthly salary history YEAR-ROUND and store it monthly, so that the six-month average can be taken for the event that applies. The average is the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months: on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025). The average drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption: full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), tapered above. | This is the single field on the certificate that cannot be reconstructed at year end. A moving six-month window is not derivable from twelve annual totals, and getting it wrong changes the exemption on the severance, not merely the disclosure. |
| 9 | Casilla 60 - Valor de la retencion | Payroll engine (tax) | Accumulate the retencion en la fuente actually practised on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period. For a RESIDENT this is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Where the employee changed residence status mid-year, sum both. Only withholding actually practised is accumulated: theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding amounts are excluded (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). | Reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee BEFORE issuing. A certificate that disagrees with the transmitted documents counts against the employer, because the XML is the tax support for the cost. |
| 10 | **═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 11 | Write zero, never blank | Engine (formatting) | The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) directs: 'En el evento en que no haya valor a registrar en alguna casilla escriba cero (0)'. Every money casilla is populated, with zero where there is nothing. | This INVERTS the electronic payroll rule, where an inapplicable element is OMITTED rather than zero-filled. Two artefacts, two opposite conventions, from the same authority. |
| 12 | Round to the nearest 1,000 | Engine (formatting) | All money casillas are expressed in Colombian pesos and approximated to the nearest 1,000, as the instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) directs and exactly as on Form 350. Apply the rounding to each casilla value, then check that the printed sums still tie - casilla 52 = sum of 36 to 51, casilla 75 = 60 + 74. | Rounding sixteen casillas independently can make casilla 52 differ from the rounded sum of the unrounded parts by up to 8,000 pesos. Compute casilla 52 from the ROUNDED casillas so the arithmetic printed on the form holds. |
| 13 | RUT consistency before issue | Engine (control) | Casillas 5 to 11 must match casillas 5, 6, 31, 32, 33, 34 and 35 of the RUT. The instruction guide repeats for each that where they do not match, THE RUT MUST BE UPDATED BEFORE THE CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED. | Do not let the certificate diverge from the register in order to meet the March deadline - the register governs. |
| 14 | Casilla 37 versus casilla 38 - the meal-payment fork | Payroll engine | Where the employee's monthly salary EXCEEDS 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026), the WHOLE meal payment goes to casilla 37 and casilla 38 stays nil. Where it does not exceed 310 UVT, the payment is not income up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334) and only the EXCESS goes to casilla 38, with nothing in casilla 37 for that concept. | Two thresholds, applied in sequence, and the outcome routes the amount to a DIFFERENT casilla. Both tests are MONTHLY, so an employee can fork one way in some months and the other way in others within the same certificate. |
| 15 | Casilla 48 and casilla 49 are mutually exclusive | Engine (validation) | An employee is either in the pre-1991 traditional severance regime or in the Ley 50 de 1990 annual-deposit regime, not both. Assert that at most one of the two is non-zero for any employee. | The only exception is a transition year in which an employee formally elected the new regime - rare, and worth an explicit override rather than a silent allowance. |
| 16 | **═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 17 | Casilla 54 combines two concepts | Engine (accumulation) | Casilla 54 carries mandatory PENSION contributions AND the solidarity-fund surcharge in ONE figure. The electronic payroll reports them as three separate elements (NIE166, NIE168, NIE170) and PILA as three separate campos (47, 51, 52). Keep them separate internally and sum them only at this casilla. | Summing them earlier makes the electronic payroll and PILA outputs impossible to produce correctly. |
| 18 | Casillas 55 and 56 split one electronic payroll element | Engine (accumulation) | Casilla 55 is voluntary contributions to the RAIS under ET art. 55; casilla 56 is voluntary contributions to VOLUNTARY pension funds under ET art. 126-1. The electronic payroll has ONE element for both (PensionVoluntaria, NIE198), so the engine must carry the distinction on the wage type. | Different legal bases, different caps in some scenarios. Combining them here is a misstatement even though the XML cannot tell them apart. |
| 19 | Casilla 58 has no electronic payroll element | Engine (accumulation) | AVC contributions to the Fondo Nacional del Ahorro have no dedicated electronic payroll element and fall to OtraDeduccion (NIE197). Tag the wage type so the amount can be recovered for this casilla and for Format 2276 numeral 28. | Without the tag the amount is indistinguishable from any other 'other deduction' at year end. |
| 20 | **═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 21 | Non-resident certificate | Payroll engine (tax) | Issue the same certificate. Casilla 52 carries the gross and casilla 60 carries 20% under ET art. 408 of the gross less the severance savings and interest of casillas 47 to 49, which are never withheld (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3) - no depuration is visible. Casillas 53 and 54 still report the contributions actually deducted, even though they did NOT reduce the withholding base for a non-resident. | Casilla 59 is reported for completeness but has no withholding effect: severance savings and their interest are not withheld for anyone (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11). |
| 22 | Mid-year residence change | Payroll engine (tax) | Issue ONE certificate for the whole period. Casilla 60 sums the months withheld at 20% under art. 408 and the months withheld under the art. 383 table. The form has no field to disclose the split. | Retain the split internally for audit and for any DIAN enquiry. The employee reconciles on their own return; the employer performs no true-up. |
| 23 | Dependants (casillas 79 to 82) | Employee master data | Populate all four casillas together where the employee claimed the ET art. 387 par. 2 dependants deduction during the period. The deduction is 10% of gross employment income capped at 32 UVT per month (COP 1,675,968 in 2026). | The same dependant is reported in Format 2276 numeral 34, which is where DIAN matches a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer. Keep the two consistent or the employee receives an enquiry. |
| 24 | Employee-declared sections (casillas 61 to 78) | The employee | Payroll does NOT populate casillas 61 to 78. They are supplied by the employee so that the certificate can substitute for the income-tax return under ET art. 380. Provide the employee with a means to supply them and leave them at zero where the employee does not. | Issuing the certificate with these sections at zero does not invalidate it - it simply means the employee cannot rely on it as a substitute return and must file. |
| 25 | **═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══** |  |  |  |
| 26 | Casilla 52 arithmetic | Engine (validation) | Casilla 52 must equal the sum of the ROUNDED casillas 36 to 51. Assert it before issuing. | Sixteen casillas. A single mis-classified concept both understates one casilla and overstates another while leaving casilla 52 correct - so also reconcile casilla 52 to the annual gross from the electronic payroll. |
| 27 | Casilla 75 arithmetic | Engine (validation) | Casilla 75 must equal casilla 60 plus casilla 74. Where the employee supplies nothing, casilla 74 is zero and casilla 75 equals casilla 60. | - |
| 28 | Casillas 79 to 82 populate together | Engine (validation) | All four dependant casillas are populated together or none is. A document number without a relationship, or a relationship without a number, is incomplete. | - |
| 29 | Cross-report reconciliation | Engine (reconciliation) | Before issuing, assert per employee: casilla 60 equals twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177; casilla 53 equals twelve months of NIE163 and the employee portion of PILA campo 55; casilla 54 equals twelve months of NIE166 + NIE168 + NIE170 and the employee portions of PILA campos 47, 51 and 52; casilla 49 equals the amount actually deposited under CO-CESANTIAS-006 in the tax year. Across the population, assert that the sum of casilla 60 equals twelve months of Form 350 casillas 93 plus 94. | Reconcile on the UNROUNDED values with a tolerance, because the four artefacts round three different ways. A material difference means a payment was made without a electronic payroll document, or a document was rejected and never re-transmitted. |

| 33 | 169.440.000 / 31.200.000 | Casilla 52 / Casilla 60 for a NON-RESIDENT | The same gross income; the flat 20% of ET art. 408 applies to all of it except the severance savings and interest of casillas 47 and 49 (never withheld, Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3): 20% x 156,000,000 = COP 31,200,000. | About four times (31,200,000 / 7,407,000 = 4.21) the resident's COP 7,407,000. Casillas 53 and 54 still report the contributions actually deducted, but they did NOT reduce the base - art. 408 taxes the gross. |
| 34 | 12.000.000 | Casilla 59 for a NON-RESIDENT | Reported, but of no effect. | Severance savings and their interest are not withheld for a non-resident either (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3, extended to every payer by Corte Constitucional C-397 de 1994; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11); the art. 206 num. 4 exemption is applied, if at all, in the employee's own return (DIAN Concepto 577 de 2020: a non-resident who must file applies ET art. 26 together with arts. 178 and 235-2, which keeps the art. 206 exemptions). |
| 35 | **═══ CROSS-REPORT RECONCILIATION FROM THIS CERTIFICATE ═══** |  |  |  |
| 36 | 7.407.000 | Equals 12 x electronic payroll NIE177 (7,406,784), approximated to the nearest 1,000 | Annual withholding for this employee. | Reconcile on unrounded values with a tolerance - the two artefacts round differently. |
| 37 | 12.000.000 | Equals CO-CESANTIAS-006 deposit | Casilla 49 equals the fund deposit made in the tax year (by 14 February 2026). | Late deposit costs ONE DAY'S SALARY PER DAY OF DELAY, per employee, uncapped - so this reconciliation has a direct financial consequence. |
| 38 | (map by meaning) | -> Format 2276 numerals 18, 19, 20 | Casilla 47 to numeral 18, casilla 49 to numeral 19, casilla 48 to numeral 20. | NOT positional. The second and third severance lines are transposed between the two artefacts. |


### Sheet: Sample File

SAMPLE FILE - CHANNEL STATEMENT AND COMPLETED-CERTIFICATE RENDERING  
WHY THERE IS NO SAMPLE FILE  
════════════  
Form 220 is NOT SUBMITTED TO ANY AUTHORITY. It is a certificate issued to  
the employee and retained by the employer (ET arts. 378-380; DUR 1625 de 2016  
art. 1.6.1.13.2.40). DIAN prescribes the FORM but no transmission format,  
because nothing is transmitted.  
There is therefore no wire format, no XSD and no import layout to sample.  
Fabricating one would be inventing a format that does not exist. What follows  
is a COMPLETED-CERTIFICATE RENDERING: the casilla-value set the engine must  
produce, which is the actual deliverable.  
Amounts are in Colombian pesos, approximated to the nearest 1,000, with ZERO  
written where a casilla has no value - both rules stated expressly in the  
instructivo.

NON-RESIDENT VARIANT  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
The same certificate for a NON-RESIDENT employee changes exactly one figure:  
52 TOTAL INGRESOS BRUTOS ............................... 169.440.000 (unchanged)  
53 Aportes obligatorios por salud ...................... 5.760.000 (unchanged)  
54 Aportes obligatorios a pensiones y solidaridad ...... 7.200.000 (unchanged)  
59 Ingreso laboral promedio ultimos seis meses ......... 12.000.000 (no effect)  
60 VALOR DE LA RETENCION EN LA FUENTE .................. 31.200.000 <== 20% x 156.000.000  
ET art. 408 taxes the GROSS at a flat 20%, except the severance savings and  
interest of casillas 47 and 49, never withheld (Ley 100 art. 135 par. 3):  
20% x 156,000,000 = 31,200,000. Casillas 53 and 54 are still certified because  
they were deducted, but they did NOT reduce the withholding base. Casilla 59 is  
reported for completeness and has no withholding effect.  
An employee who ACQUIRES RESIDENCE mid-year receives ONE certificate; casilla 60  
sums the 20% months and the art. 383 months, and the form has no field to  
disclose the split. Retain the split internally for audit.

in the information return. There is also a Form 220 concept with NO 2276  
counterpart in this list (the meal payments UP TO 41 UVT, which 2276 reports  
separately at numeral 32 as informative and Form 220 does not report at all)  
and a 2276 concept with no Form 220 counterpart (numeral 6, emolumentos  
eclesiasticos, which Form 220 folds into casilla 39).

Each file carries at most 5,000 records; a population above 5,000 beneficiaries is sent in several files distinguished by the consecutive number (DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4, Res. 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1, entry T3.45). |

| 19 | Version | v1.2 |
| 22 | DETAILED COMPLIANCE NOTES (Colombia-specific) |  |
| 23 | SUBMISSION CHANNEL |  |
| 24 | - Channel: file_upload (XML) into the DIAN third-party (exogenous) information service \| Portal: www.dian.gov.co, Electronic Computer Services, with the Electronic Signature Instrument (IFE) \| Source: DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 arts. 1.3.7.1.1 and 1.3.10.1 \| The XML schema is defined by the published technical specifications of Format 2276 version 4. |  |
| 25 | - This is NOT machine-to-machine. Unlike the electronic payroll there is no SOAP service, no document signature and no synchronous ApplicationResponse - the employer uploads a file through an authenticated portal session and reads the outcome on screen. |  |
| 26 | - The word 'XML' is used here because Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists Format 2276 among the formats with published technical specifications, and the exogena service accepts XML. The resolution itself does not print the XSD, but the official technical specification does: Annex 45 of Res. DIAN 000162 of 2023 (Format 2276 version 4, section 4 'Esquema XSD'), which Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists as T3.45. Its root element is mas, the header is Cab and each beneficiary is one rentra element; the numerals travel as the rentra attributes named in column H of the Formato 2276 Spec sheet. The physical file is an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year of sending (four digits; Anexo T3.45), cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file. |  |
| 27 | - The tax portal is not the social-security channel and not the information operator. Format 2276 goes to DIAN; PILA never does. |  |
| 28 | INTEGRATION TYPE AND DIRECTION |  |
| 29 | - Integration: outbound file generation only. No inbound file: the portal returns an on-screen validation outcome, which the engine captures for the audit trail. |  |
| 30 | - product_mapping_required = true. The format needs three separate severance savings lines, the meal-payment split at the 41-UVT threshold across TWO numerals, the rolling six-month average labour income, the RAIS-versus-voluntary-pension split that the electronic payroll cannot make, the AVC amount that has no electronic payroll element at all, and each dependant's identity document. None of these is derivable at year end from annual totals. |  |
| 31 | - NOT DERIVABLE FROM THE MONTHLY FILINGS. It has its own field list, its own validation and its own deadline. It also carries concepts Form 220 does not - numeral 6 (ecclesiastical emoluments), numeral 32 (meal payments up to 41 UVT, informative) and numerals 30, 31, 35 and 36. |  |
| 32 | RESIDENT / NON-RESIDENT TREATMENT |  |
| 33 | - RESIDENT: numeral 29 carries the ET art. 383 progressive-table withholding, and numerals 23 to 28 carry the contributions and voluntary savings that depurated the base. |  |
| 34 | - NON-RESIDENT: numeral 29 carries the FLAT 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS less the severance numerals 18 to 20, which are never withheld (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11). Numerals 23 and 24 still report the contributions actually deducted, but they did NOT reduce the base - art. 408 admits no depuration. Numeral 33 is reported where severance was paid, without withholding effect. |  |
| 35 | - The format has NO tax-residence field: the country in numeral 4 is the country of the beneficiary's address (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025), not a tax-residence marker. Tax residence is therefore invisible to DIAN in this return except through the arithmetic relationship between numerals 22 and 29 - a non-resident's numeral 29 is close to exactly 20% of numeral 22 less numerals 18 to 20, which is itself a useful internal control. |  |
| 36 | - Res. 227 par. 5 draws a SECOND distinction that is easy to confuse with residence: payments to natural persons receiving work income NOT from an employment relationship are reported HERE where they were withheld under ET art. 383, and in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats where they were not. That test is about the WITHHOLDING REGIME, not about residence. |  |
| 37 | - Where a non-resident's work was performed ENTIRELY outside Colombia the income is foreign-source, was not withheld, and is not reported here at all (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019). |  |
| 38 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 39 | - Numerals 5 to 33 map almost one for one to Form 220 casillas 36 to 60 (CO-DIAN-004) - but THE SECOND AND THIRD SEVERANCE LINES ARE TRANSPOSED: numeral 19 is Form 220 casilla 49 and numeral 20 is casilla 48. Map by meaning, never by position. |  |
| 40 | - Numeral 29 summed across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casillas 93 plus 94 (CO-DIAN-002), and per employee to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 (CO-DIAN-001). |  |
| 41 | - Numerals 23 and 24 reconcile to the employee portions of PILA Record Tipo 2 campos 55, 47, 51 and 52 (CO-PILA-003). |  |
| 42 | - Numeral 19 must reconcile to the deposit made under CO-CESANTIAS-006 in February of the reported year - the deposit is counted in the year it is made (ET art. 27 num. 3; Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element ceco). |  |
| 43 | - Numeral 34 must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 - DIAN checks a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer. |  |
| 44 | - Numeral 16 is mutually exclusive with Format 5247 concept 5102 for the same payment (Res. 227 para. 7): employer-paid educational support is reported here, third-party administered support there. Format 5247 is not a payroll filing. |  |
| 45 | - Numerals 30, 31, 35 and 36 are NOT payroll fields - VAT and collaboration-contract identifiers, owned by the employer's tax function outside payroll. |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - THIRD-PARTY INFORMATION RETURN ON WORK AND PENSION INCOME - FORMAT 2276 VERSION 4  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHO is reported on Format 2276 and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Indefinite-term employee (indefinite-term contract) | YES | The core private-sector population. CST art. 47; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 5. |
| 7 | Fixed-term employee (fixed-term contract, max 4 years) | YES | Identical reporting treatment to an indefinite-term contract. CST art. 46; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6. |
| 8 | Specific-work or task employee (contract por obra o labor) | YES | An employment contract; CST art. 46. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 3 (Obra o Labor). |
| 9 | Occasional / accidental / transitory worker (< 1 month, non-core activity) | YES | Still an employee under CST art. 6. Reported on every filing; the PILA return type and the day counts differ, not the obligation. |
| 10 | Part-time employee | YES | Colombia has no separate part-time regime. Reported normally; the PILA contribution base is floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) except for the worker type 51 partial-time regime. |
| 11 | All-inclusive salary employee (all-inclusive salary, >= 13 SMMLV) | YES | CST art. 132 num. 2. Reported with the integral-salary flag set; the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, and the electronic payroll carries SalarioIntegral = true. |
| 12 | Apprentice (apprenticeship contract) | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19). |
| 13 | Intern / practical placement (practicas o pasantias) | YES | Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 5. Reported where remunerated. |
| 14 | Teleworkers and remote workers | YES | Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158). |
| 15 | Resident foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | Full reporting. Withheld under the ET art. 383 progressive table once tax residence is acquired. |
| 16 | NON-RESIDENT foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix. |
| 17 | Employed old-age pensioner in active service | YES | PILA worker sub-type 01; no pension contribution (PILA pension rate field = 0), health and the levies still apply. |
| 18 | Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract | YES | Reported as an ordinary employee where an employment contract exists. |
| 19 | Independent contractor (service contract) | NO | Not an employee. The contractor self-files PILA on 40% of fees (return types I / Y, descoped) and is reported by the payer in the third-party information return, not in this employer filing. Withholding on their fees does pass through Form 350, but under a different casilla. |
| 20 | Public-sector employee (contributor type 47, SGP-funded entity) | NO | Public-sector only. Public-sector employees are reported through PILA return types T and F, which are outside the scope of this specification. |
| 21 | Non-executive director paid fees only (junta directiva) | NO | Not payroll income. Fees paid to a non-executive director who holds no employment contract are not generated by the payroll engine, and payroll contributes nothing to the record. Res. 227 par. 5 governs their reporting: where the fee was withheld under ET art. 383 it is reported in Format 2276 numeral 9 (fees) by the employer's tax function, outside payroll; where art. 383 did not apply it is reported in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead (see 'Natural person paid work income OUTSIDE an employment relationship' below). |
| 22 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by a fund, not by the employer | NO | The paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. |
| 23 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 24 | Annual salary and work income by concept | YES | Numerals 5 to 17, itemised in thirteen separate concepts. |
| 25 | Ecclesiastical emoluments as a separate concept | YES | Numeral 6 - a concept Form 220 does NOT separate, folding it into casilla 39. |
| 26 | Meal payments up to 41 UVT | YES, but informative only | Numeral 32 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pagahuvt), for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Res. 227 para. 1: 'se considera de caracter informativo'. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22, because it is income of the food supplier, not of the employee. Form 220 has no counterpart casilla. |
| 27 | Meal payments above 41 UVT | YES | Numeral 8 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vaex), as taxable income of the employee, for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT; where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole meal payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop). |
| 28 | Severance, split three ways | YES | Numerals 18 (paid to the employee), 19 (deposited to the fund in the reported year - the February deposit belongs to the year of the deposit, ET art. 27 num. 3) and 20 (traditional pre-1991 regime). Note the ordering difference against Form 220. |
| 29 | Employee mandatory contributions | YES | Numerals 23 and 24. Pension and the solidarity fund are COMBINED in numeral 24. On an employer-paid pensioner's record the health and solidarity deductions on the pension are reported in the same two numerals (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements apos and apof). |
| 30 | Voluntary savings, split four ways | YES | Numerals 25 (RAIS), 26 (voluntary pension funds), 27 (AFC) and 28 (AVC). The electronic payroll has one element for the first two and none for the fourth. |
| 31 | Rolling six-month average labour income | YES | Numeral 33, but ONLY for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies. |
| 32 | Withholding practised | YES | Numeral 29 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vare): the withholding actually practised, resident or non-resident alike; hypothetical or contingent amounts are excluded. |
| 33 | Employer social-security contributions | NO | The return reports the BENEFICIARY's income and the BENEFICIARY's contributions. The employer's cost appears only on PILA. |
| 34 | VAT as a higher cost and VAT withholding | NO | Numerals 30 and 31 are not payroll figures: Colombian employment income carries no VAT. They are relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the ET art. 383 table, are populated by the employer's tax function outside payroll, and are written as zero on every employee record (Res. 227 para. 2). |
| 35 | Trust and collaboration-contract identifiers | NO | Numerals 35 and 36. Res. 227 para. 4: for an ordinary employer reporting under concept 1 they 'no se deben diligenciar'. |
| 36 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 37 | Reported on the accrual (causacion) date | NO | Every Colombian payroll filing is keyed to the PAYMENT or credit-in-account date, not to the accrual date. A December salary paid in January falls in the January filing. |
| 38 | Reported on the payment or credit-in-account date | YES | The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276. |
| 39 | A semi-monthly payroll produces two filings a month | NO | It does not. The electronic payroll is expressly ONE monthly document per employee 'irrespective of whether the obliged party makes payments in different or shorter periods' (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2). PILA and Form 350 are likewise monthly. |
| 40 | Nil period still filed | NO | Format 2276 is annual and carries one record per beneficiary to whom work or pension income was paid or credited in account in the tax year (Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1). A beneficiary whose withholding was nil still gets a record, with zero in every value numeral (par. 2 - see 'Employee whose withholding was nil'). Where no work or pension income was paid or credited in account to any person in the tax year there is no beneficiary and payroll generates no Format 2276 record; the format has no nil record. A monthly nil period does not arise for this return: every amount is an annual accumulation by payment date. |
| 41 | Corrections handled by re-filing the whole period | VARIES | Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8). |
| 42 | **═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══** |  |  |
| 43 | Employee who left during the year | YES | One record covering the payments actually made in the year. There is no partial-year marker; the amounts simply reflect the shorter period. |
| 44 | Employee whose withholding was nil | YES | A record is still required. Res. 227 para. 2: 'Las casillas de valores son de obligatorio diligenciamiento. En caso de no tener ningun valor, se deben diligenciar con cero (0)'. |
| 45 | Natural person paid work income OUTSIDE an employment relationship | YES | Res. 227 par. 5: reported here WHERE the payment was withheld under ET art. 383. Where art. 383 did not apply, it goes to the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead - not here. |
| 46 | Work income paid out of trust assets | PARTIAL | Reported with numeral 1 = 2 (Fiduciarias) and the trust identified in numeral 35. Not an ordinary corporate payroll case; where it arises, the reporting party is the fiduciaria, not the employer. |
| 47 | Educational support administered by a third party | NO | Res. 227 para. 7 sends it to Format 5247 concept 5102. Only support paid DIRECTLY by the employer goes to numeral 16. |
| 48 | Employee with a dependant claimed under art. 387 par. 2 | YES | Numeral 34. Must agree with Form 220 casillas 79 and 80 - this is where DIAN checks a dependant claimed twice. |
| 49 | Employee who acquired residence mid-year | YES | ONE record. Numeral 29 sums the 20% months and the art. 383 months; the format has no field to disclose the split. |
| 50 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by the EMPLOYER through payroll (company pension) | YES | One record per pensioner, identified with the recipient's own document (a survivor or substitute pension in the name of the person who receives it). Numeral 21 (element peju) carries the pension payments of the year - the monthly mesadas and the additional mesadas; numeral 23 (element apos) the health contribution deducted from the pension; numeral 24 (element apof) a solidarity-fund deduction where it applies; numeral 17 (element potro) any payment to the pensioner that is not the pension itself (e.g. a health-plan offset compensation); numeral 29 the withholding actually practised, which is nil where the pension does not exceed 1,000 UVT a month (ET art. 206 num. 5). Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 numerals 17, 21, 23, 24 and 29. |

### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ SUBMISSION FORMAT ═══  

| Row | Channel | file_upload into the DIAN third-party (exogenous) information service at www.dian.gov.co, in an authenticated portal session signed with the Electronic Signature Instrument (IFE). |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | File format | XML prepared to the DIAN technical specifications for Format 2276 version 4: an XML document in ISO-8859-1 encoding, named Dmuisca_ccmmmmmvvaaaacccccccc.xml (cc = 01 insertion / 02 replacement, mmmmm = format 02276, vv = version 04, aaaa = year of sending (four digits; Anexo T3.45), cccccccc = consecutive file number), with at most 5,000 records per file. DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.3.10.1 lists the format in its formats-y-especificaciones-tecnicas table as entry T3.45, version 4. |
| 5 | Technical specifications | The technical specifications annex of Format 2276 version 4 fixes the XML ELEMENT NAMES, the field ordering and the column lengths; it is a SEPARATE document from Res. 227, which prescribes WHAT to report, not how the file is shaped. The XML names used in this specification are those of the official XSD (Annex 45 of Res. DIAN 000162 of 2023, section 4): root mas, header Cab, one rentra element per beneficiary, numerals as rentra attributes (column H of the Formato 2276 Spec sheet). The unique key of a record is entinfo + tdocb + nitb + identfc + tdocpcc + nitpcc, which must not repeat among the records sent for the same year or period. The productive layout is configured from the published technical specifications. |
| 6 | Why this is NOT machine-to-machine | There is no SOAP service, no XAdES document signature and no synchronous ApplicationResponse. Contrast the electronic payroll (CO-DIAN-001), which has all three. Here the employer uploads through an authenticated portal session and reads the outcome on screen. |
| 7 | What the model below is | A NEUTRAL FIELD MODEL - the resolution's own thirty-six numerals in their published order, plus the envelope attributes the deadline depends on. It is a LOGICAL MODEL, not the wire format. |
| 8 | **═══ LOGICAL MODEL - ONE RECORD PER BENEFICIARY ═══** |  |
| 9 | Envelope | Informant NIT \| Taxpayer category (Gran Taxpayer / legal entity / natural person) \| Tax year \| Format 2276 version 4. In the XML the header element Cab carries, all mandatory (Anexo T3.45 section 2.1): Ano (year of sending, AAAA), CodCpt (1 = insertion, 2 = replacement), Formato (2276), Version (4), NumEnvio (consecutive number of the sending within the year, up to 8 digits), FecEnvio (AAAA-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), FecInicial and FecFinal (first and last day of the tax year reported, AAAA-MM-DD), ValorTotal (control total - defined by the annex as the sum of the attribute tdocb across the records) and CantReg (number of rentra records in the file, at most 5,000). The informant NIT and the taxpayer category are not header attributes: they come from the portal session and drive the deadline. |
| 10 | Block 1 - Reporting entity | N01 Entidad informante (code 1 to 8) \| N35 Identificacion del fideicomiso (only where N01 = 2) \| N36 Tipo documento e identificacion del participante en contrato (only where N01 is 3 to 8) |
| 11 | Block 2 - Beneficiary | N02 Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion \| N03 Surnames and given names \| N04 Ubicacion (direccion, departamento, municipio y pais - pais always populated; direccion, departamento and municipio only where the country of residence is Colombia, Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025) |
| 12 | Block 3 - Income | N05 Salaries \| N06 Emolumentos eclesiasticos \| N07 Bonos, cheques, tarjetas, vales \| N08 Exceso alimentacion > 41 UVT \| N09 Fees \| N10 Services \| N11 Commissions \| N12 Prestaciones sociales \| N13 Travel allowances \| N14 Representation expenses \| N15 Compensaciones trabajo cooperative associate \| N16 Educational financial support \| N17 Other payments |
| 13 | Block 4 - Cesantias | N18 Cesantias e intereses de cesantias efectivamente pagadas al empleado \| N19 Consignadas al fondo \| N20 Regimen tradicional del CST |
| 14 | Block 5 - Pensiones y total | N21 Pensiones de jubilacion, old age or disability \| N22 TOTAL GROSS INCOME |
| 15 | Block 6 - Contributions | N23 Compulsory contributions salud \| N24 Compulsory pension and solidarity contributions \| N25 Voluntary contributions RAIS \| N26 Voluntary contributions to pension funds \| N27 Contributions AFC \| N28 Contributions AVC |
| 16 | Block 7 - Withholdings e IVA | N29 Valor de las retenciones en la fuente por pagos de rentas de trabajo o pensiones \| N30 Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA), mayor valor del costo o gasto \| N31 Retencion en la fuente a titulo de Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA) |
| 17 | Block 8 - Informativos y especiales | N32 Alimentacion hasta 41 UVT (INFORMATIVE, outside N22) \| N33 Average employment income ultimos 6 meses \| N34 Economic dependant |
| 18 | **═══ INTERPRETIVE RULES PRINTED IN RES. 227 ART. 1.30.7.1.1 ═══** |  |
| 19 | Paragrafo 1 | Numeral 32 (meal payments up to 41 UVT) 'se considera de caracter informativo'. It therefore does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. |
| 20 | Paragrafo 2 | 'Las casillas de valores son de obligatorio diligenciamiento. En caso de no tener ningun valor, se deben diligenciar con cero (0).' Every value field is populated; write ZERO, never blank. |
| 21 | Paragrafo 3 | The eight-value Reporting entity code table - reproduced on Sheet 6. |
| 22 | Paragrafo 4 | For an ordinary employer the Reporting entity is concept 1 (Informante general), and numerals 35 and 36 are NOT filled. Where the income is paid out of trust assets, concept 2 plus numeral 35 and no numeral 36. Where it is paid under a collaboration contract, the contract concept plus numeral 36 and no numeral 35. |
| 23 | Paragrafo 5 | Payments to natural persons receiving work income NOT from an employment, legal or statutory relationship, but withheld under ET art. 383, ARE reported in Format 2276. Where art. 383 withholding did NOT apply, they are reported in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead. |
| 24 | Paragrafo 6 | 'El valor reportado en el numeral 7, no debe contener la informacion reportada en los demas numerales del Formato 2276.' Numeral 7 is residual - it must not double-report anything already in another numeral. |
| 25 | Paragrafo 7 | Educational support paid DIRECTLY by the employer goes to numeral 16; support administered by a THIRD PARTY goes to Format 5247 concept 5102. Added by Resolution 188 of 2024 art. 8; first applies to tax year 2025, filed in calendar 2026 (art. 1.3.9.1.3 para. 5). |
| 26 | **═══ AMOUNT AND ROUNDING CONVENTION ═══** |  |
| 27 | Rounding | Positive integers in whole pesos - no decimals, no sign, no thousand separators - zero-filled where nil (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2). This is the fourth Colombian convention encountered across the six filings, alongside the electronic payroll (2 decimals round-half-to-even), PILA (round UP to the next 100) and Form 350 and 220 (nearest 1,000). Store the unrounded value once and apply each convention at output. |
| 28 | Nil values | Write ZERO. Res. 227 para. 2 is explicit, and the technical specification (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025) takes positive integer values only. This matches Form 220 and INVERTS the electronic payroll, where an inapplicable element is omitted. |
| 29 | **═══ FILING CALENDAR - RES. 227 ART. 1.30.9.1.3 ═══** |  |
| 30 | Grandes Taxpayers | By the LAST digit of the NIT: 1 = 17th business day of April; 2 = 18th business day of April; 3 = 1st business day of May; 4 = 2nd; 5 = 3rd; 6 = 4th; 7 = 5th; 8 = 6th; 9 = 7th; 0 = 8th business day of May. |
| 31 | Legal entities y naturales | By the LAST TWO digits of the NIT, in five-number bands: 01-05 = 9th business day of May, rising one business day per band through 51-55 = 19th business day of May, then 56-60 = 1st business day of June, through 96-00 = 9th business day of June. |
| 32 | Category tested at filing | Art. 1.3.9.1.3 para. 1: the Gran Taxpayer, legal-person or natural-person status is the one held AT THE MOMENT OF FILING, not at the year end being reported. |
| 33 | Three different deadline rules | Form 350 uses the LAST digit and the 7th-16th business day of the following MONTH. PILA uses the LAST TWO digits and the 2nd-16th business day of the following MONTH. This return uses the LAST digit for Grandes Taxpayers and the LAST TWO for everyone else, in MAY or JUNE of the following YEAR. Do not generalise one rule to another filing. |

### Sheet: Population Rules

POPULATION RULES - HOW TO FILL EACH FIELD FROM PAYROLL  

| Row | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | **═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 4 | Numeral 1 - Reporting entity | Configuration | For an ordinary employer reporting employment and pension income, set the code to 1 - Informante general - and leave numerals 35 and 36 BLANK. Res. 227 para. 4 states this in terms. Depart from concept 1 only where the income was genuinely paid out of trust assets (concept 2, plus numeral 35) or under a collaboration contract (conceptos 3 to 8, plus numeral 36). | The three cases are mutually exclusive and each drives a different pair of numerals. Getting the concept wrong changes which identifier fields DIAN expects and produces a validation failure rather than a silent misstatement. |
| 5 | Numerals 5 to 21 - the income concepts | Payroll engine | Accumulate each concept separately for the whole tax year on the PAYMENT date. Then apply the two exclusion rules the resolution imposes: para. 6 forbids numeral 7 from repeating anything reported in another numeral, and para. 7 sends third-party-administered educational support to Format 5247 rather than to numeral 16. | Note two concepts that Form 220 does NOT separate: numeral 6 (ecclesiastical emoluments), which Form 220 folds into casilla 39, and numeral 32 (meal payments up to 41 UVT), for which Form 220 has no casilla at all. |
| 6 | Numeral 22 - Total gross income | Engine (computed) | Sum numerals 5 to 21. DO NOT include numeral 32: para. 1 makes it informative, because meal payments below the threshold are income of the food supplier and not of the employee. Assert that numeral 22 equals Form 220 casilla 52 for the same employee and year. | Including numeral 32 in the total overstates the employee's gross income and breaks the reconciliation to Form 220 - and it is an easy mistake because every other value numeral does enter the total. |
| 7 | Numeral 33 - Average employment income | Payroll engine | Populate ONLY for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance or its interest was paid or deposited in the year, so that numerals 18, 19 or 20 are non-zero. The resolution says 'UNICAMENTE'. Maintain the rolling six-month average year-round; on a termination use the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT. | The average cannot be reconstructed from annual totals at year end. Populating it for every employee regardless is also wrong: the resolution restricts it, and an unnecessary value invites an enquiry. |
| 8 | Numeral 34 - Economic dependant | Employee master data | Populate the document type and number of each dependant claimed under ET art. 387 para. 2 during the year. Keep it byte-identical to Form 220 casillas 79 and 80. | THIS IS THE FIELD DIAN USES TO CROSS-CHECK a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer - typically both parents claiming the same child. A divergence between this return and the certificate the employee holds produces an enquiry to the employee, not to the employer. |
| 9 | **═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 10 | Write zero, never blank | Engine (formatting) | Res. 227 para. 2: 'Las casillas de valores son de obligatorio diligenciamiento. En caso de no tener ningun valor, se deben diligenciar con cero (0).' Every value numeral is populated, as a positive integer (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025). | Matches Form 220 and INVERTS the electronic payroll, where an inapplicable element is omitted rather than zero-filled. Two DIAN artefacts, two opposite conventions. |
| 11 | Numeral 7 must not double-report | Engine (validation) | Par. 6 forbids numeral 7 from containing anything reported in another numeral. Before filing, assert that no amount is counted both in numeral 7 and in numerals 5, 8, 12, 17 or elsewhere. | The risk is real because voucher and card payments can plausibly be classified as salary (numeral 5), as a meal benefit (numerals 8 or 32) or as other payments (numeral 17). Fix the classification on the wage type, once. |
| 12 | The meal-payment fork | Payroll engine | Apply the two ET art. 387-1 tests MONTHLY and in sequence. First: does the employee's monthly salary exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026)? If YES, the whole meal payment goes to numeral 7 and both numeral 8 and numeral 32 stay nil for that month. If NO, split the payment at 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334): the part up to the threshold goes to numeral 32 (informative), and the EXCESS goes to numeral 8 (taxable). ET art. 387-1; Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pabop, vaex and pagahuvt. | Three possible destinations for one payment, decided monthly. An employee can fork one way in some months and the other way in others within the same annual record, so the accumulation must be per month and then summed - not decided once on the annual figures. |
| 13 | Numerals 35 and 36 are mutually exclusive | Engine (validation) | Numeral 35 is populated only where numeral 1 = 2; numeral 36 only where numeral 1 is 3 to 8; both blank where numeral 1 = 1. Never both. | Res. 227 par. 4 spells out each of the three cases explicitly. |
| 14 | Numerals 19 and 20 are mutually exclusive per employee | Engine (validation) | An employee is in the Ley 50 de 1990 fund-deposit regime or in the pre-1991 traditional regime, not both. Assert that at most one of numerals 19 and 20 is non-zero for any beneficiary. | The only exception is a formal regime election in the transition year - rare enough to warrant an explicit override rather than a silent allowance. |
| 15 | **═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 16 | Whole pesos, no separators | Engine (formatting) | Amounts are positive integers in whole Colombian pesos with no decimals, no sign and no thousand separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025; Res. 227 para. 2). Round once, at the annual accumulation, not per month. | This is the fourth rounding convention across the six filings. Store the unrounded value once and apply each convention at output; never derive one artefact's figures from another's rounded output. |
| 17 | Numeral 24 combines two concepts | Engine (accumulation) | Numeral 24 carries mandatory PENSION contributions AND the solidarity-fund surcharge in one figure, exactly as Form 220 casilla 54 does. The electronic payroll reports three separate elements and PILA three separate campos. | Sum them only at this point. Combining them earlier makes the monthly artefacts impossible to produce correctly. |
| 18 | Numerals 25 and 26 split one electronic payroll element | Engine (accumulation) | Numeral 25 is voluntary RAIS contributions under ET art. 55; numeral 26 is voluntary contributions to VOLUNTARY pension funds under ET art. 126-1. The electronic payroll has ONE element for both (PensionVoluntaria, NIE198). | Carry the distinction on the wage type from configuration. It cannot be recovered from the XML at year end. |
| 19 | Numeral 28 has no electronic payroll element | Engine (accumulation) | AVC contributions to the Fondo Nacional del Ahorro have no dedicated electronic payroll element and fall to OtraDeduccion (NIE197). Tag the wage type so the amount can be recovered here and at Form 220 casilla 58. | Without the tag the amount is indistinguishable from any other 'other deduction' in the annual accumulation. |
| 20 | **═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 21 | Numeral 29 - RESIDENT | Payroll engine (tax) | Accumulate the withholding actually practised under the ET art. 383 progressive table, Procedure 1 or Procedure 2, on the art. 388 depurated base - the withholding actually practised, never a hypothetical or contingent amount (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vare). Assert that it equals Form 220 casilla 60 for the same employee and twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177. | An employee whose depurated base fell in the 0% band all year still gets a record, with numeral 29 at zero and numerals 5 to 22 populated. |
| 22 | Numeral 29 - NON-RESIDENT | Payroll engine (tax) | Accumulate the flat 20% of ET art. 408 applied to the GROSS, excluding severance savings and their interest (numerals 18 to 20), which are never withheld (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11). Numerals 23 and 24 still report the contributions actually deducted, but they did NOT reduce the base - art. 408 admits no depuration. Numeral 33 is reported where severance was paid, without withholding effect. | USEFUL INTERNAL CONTROL: for a pure non-resident record, numeral 29 should be almost exactly 20% of numeral 22 less numerals 18 to 20. A material divergence means either a residence change during the year or a misclassification. The format has no tax-residence field (the country in numeral 4 is the country of the beneficiary's address), so this arithmetic is the only signal. |
| 23 | Mid-year residence change | Payroll engine (tax) | Produce ONE record. Numeral 29 sums the months withheld at 20% under art. 408 and the months withheld under the art. 383 table. The format has no field to disclose the split. | Retain the split internally. It also breaks the 20%-of-numeral-22 control above, so document the reason before the control fires. |
| 24 | Non-employment work income under par. 5 | Payroll engine / accounts payable | Where the employer pays a natural person work income that does NOT arise from an employment, legal or statutory relationship, report it HERE if it was withheld under ET art. 383 (art. 383 para. 2, added by Law 2277 of 2022 art. 8, using the payments mensualizados method). Where art. 383 withholding did NOT apply, report it in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead - not here. | The test is about the WITHHOLDING REGIME, not about residence and not about employment status. It is the most commonly misread paragraph of the article, and it determines which FORMAT the payment appears in, not merely which numeral. |
| 25 | Work performed entirely abroad by a non-resident | Payroll engine (tax) | Foreign-source income, not withheld, and NOT reported in this return at all. | The corresponding field is the electronic payroll place of work (NIE050). | 27 | Numeral 22 arithmetic | Engine (validation) | Numeral 22 must equal the sum of numerals 5 to 21, EXCLUDING numeral 32. Assert it, and assert equality with Form 220 casilla 52 for the same employee. | The exclusion of numeral 32 is the trap. Every other value numeral enters the total. |
| 28 | Numerals 8 and 32 are a pair | Engine (validation) | Where either is non-zero the other is normally non-zero too, because the same underlying payment is split at 41 UVT. A positional mapping swaps the fund deposit and the traditional-regime amount, and the error is invisible in the totals because both feed numeral 22. |
