### Sheet: Sample File

SAMPLE FILE - CHANNEL STATEMENT AND NEUTRAL RECORD MODEL  
WHY THERE IS NO XML SAMPLE  
═══════════  
Format 2276 version 4 is uploaded as a file to the DIAN third-party (exogenous) information  
service, and the exogena service accepts XML. This is established by  
DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 arts. 1.3.7.1.1 and 1.3.10.1.  
What is not published inside the resolution itself is the  
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS annex for Format 2276 version 4 - the document that  
fixes the XML element names, the field ordering and the column lengths. The  
resolution only points to it ("de acuerdo con los parametros establecidos en las  
especificaciones tecnicas del Formato 2276 Version 4") and lists it in the  
formats table at art. 1.3.10.1 as entry T3.45.  
An XML instance is therefore not reproduced here: its element names are  
fixed by the technical specifications, not by the resolution.  
What follows instead is a NEUTRAL RECORD MODEL: the resolution's own thirty-six  
numerals in their published order, populated with the worked example. This is  
the content the engine must produce; the wrapper comes from the especificaciones  
tecnicas.  
PRODUCTIVE LAYOUT: the published especificaciones tecnicas for Format 2276 v4  
fix the element name, ordinal position and column length of each numeral  
below; the productive layout is configured from them.  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
ENVELOPE (attributes the deadline and validation depend on)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
Informant NIT ......................... 900123456  
Taxpayer category ..................... Persona juridica  
Tax year reported ..................... 2026  
Format / version ...................... 2276 / 4 (Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1, T3.45)  
Deadline .............................. 1st business day of June 2027  
(NIT ends 56; art. 1.3.9.1.3)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
RECORD - ONE PER BENEFICIARY  
Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025, art. 1.3.7.1.1, numerals 1 to 36 in published order  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
N01 Entidad informante ...................... 1 (Informante general)  
N02 Tipo doc. y numero de identificacion .... 13 / 1020304050  
N03 Apellidos y nombres ..................... PEREZ / GOMEZ / JUAN / CARLOS  
N04 Ubicacion del beneficiario .............. 11 / 001 / 169 (Bogota D.C.; pais 169 = Colombia - direccion, dpto. and municipio populated)  
N05 Pagos por salarios ...................... 144000000  
N06 Pagos por emolumentos eclesiasticos ..... 0  
N07 Bonos, cheques, tarjetas, vales, etc. ... 0  
N08 Exceso alimentacion > 41 UVT (art.387-1) 0  
N09 Pagos por honorarios .................... 0  
N10 Pagos por servicios ..................... 0  
N11 Pagos por comisiones .................... 0  
N12 Pagos por prestaciones sociales ......... 12000000  
N13 Pagos por viaticos ...................... 0  
N14 Pagos por gastos de representacion ...... 0  
N15 Compensaciones trabajo asociado coop. ... 0  
N16 Apoyos economicos educativos (Estado) ... 0  
N17 Otros pagos ............................. 0  
N18 Cesantias e intereses PAGADAS al empleado 1440000 -> F220 casilla 47  
N19 Cesantias CONSIGNADAS al fondo, Feb 2026 12000000 -> F220 casilla 49 (NOT 48)  
N20 Cesantias REGIMEN TRADICIONAL del CST ... 0 -> F220 casilla 48 (NOT 49)  
N21 Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez, invalidez 0  
N22 TOTAL INGRESOS BRUTOS ................... 169440000  
(numerals 5 to 21; numeral 32 is EXCLUDED - par. 1 makes it informative)  
N23 Aportes obligatorios por salud .......... 5760000  
N24 Aportes obligatorios pensiones y FSP .... 7200000  
N25 Aportes voluntarios RAIS ................ 0  
N26 Aportes voluntarios fondos de pensiones . 0  
N27 Aportes a cuentas AFC ................... 0  
N28 Aportes a cuentas AVC ................... 0  
N29 RETENCIONES PRACTICADAS ................. 7406784  
N30 IVA mayor valor del costo o gasto ....... 0 (not a payroll field)  
N31 Retencion de IVA ........................ 0 (not a payroll field)  
N32 Alimentacion mensual hasta 41 UVT ....... 0 INFORMATIVE - outside N22  
N33 Ingreso laboral promedio ultimos 6 meses 12000000 (only where art.206 num.4 applies)  
N34 Dependiente economico ................... (blank) (none claimed)  
N35 Identificacion del fideicomiso .......... (blank) (par. 4: blank under concepto 1)  
N36 Participante en contrato ................ (blank) (par. 4: blank under concepto 1)  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
NON-RESIDENT VARIANT  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
The same record for a NON-RESIDENT differs in exactly one numeral - the format  
has no tax-residence field (the country in N04 is the country of the address):  
N22 TOTAL INGRESOS BRUTOS ................... 169440000 (unchanged)  
N23 Aportes obligatorios por salud .......... 5760000 (unchanged - still deducted)  
N24 Aportes obligatorios pensiones y FSP .... 7200000 (unchanged - still deducted)  
N29 WITHHOLDINGS MADE ................. 31200000 <== 20% x (N22 - N18 - N19), ET art. 408  
N33 Ingreso laboral promedio ................ 12000000 (reported, no effect)  
INTERNAL CONTROL: for a pure non-resident record N29 / (N22 - N18 to N20) = 20.00%.  
For this resident it is 4.37%. Because the format carries no residence flag,  
that ratio is the only signal available - and a mid-year residence change  
legitimately breaks it, so document the reason before the control fires.  
The contributions in N23 and N24 are still reported because they were still  
deducted, but they did NOT reduce the withholding base: ET art. 408 taxes the  
gross with no depuration (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). N33 is reported  
where severance was paid but has no effect, because the art. 206 num. 4  
exemption belongs to the resident ID card-general regime.  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
THE FOUR TRAPS IN THIS RECORD  
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
1. N32 is INFORMATIVE and does NOT enter N22 (par. 1). Every other value numeral  
does. Including it overstates gross income and breaks the reconciliation to  
Formulario 220 casilla 52.  
2. N19 and N20 are TRANSPOSED against Formulario 220 casillas 48 and 49. Map by  
MEANING. A positional mapping swaps the fund deposit and the traditional-  
regime amount, and the error is invisible in N22 because both feed it.  
3. N07 must not double-report anything in another numeral (par. 6). Voucher and  
card payments can plausibly be classified as salary, as a meal benefit or as  
other payments - fix the classification on the wage type, once.  
4. N33 is restricted by the word UNICAMENTE to employees to whom ET art. 206  
num. 4 applies. Populating it for everyone is as wrong as omitting it when  
required.

| 25 | - THE RECIPIENT IS NOT A GOVERNMENT AUTHORITY. The money goes to a private fondo de cesantias, or to the state-owned FNA, in an individual account in the employee's name. | 26 | - THE OPERATOR IS THE SAME KIND OF INTERMEDIARY AS FOR PILA, BUT THE SERVICE IS NOT PILA. Simple S.A. notes that the login is the same one used for PILA, which is the source of the frequent error of building a PILA return and expecting the severance savings to be in it. |  |

INBOUND: CO-IN-SEVERANCE SAVINGS-CONFIRMATION, the deposit confirmation evidencing compliance with the February deadline. Both directions are modelled on Sheet 4 - the outbound record as T01-T20, the inbound values as E10, E11, E90, E91 and E93. |  |
| 31 | - product_mapping_required = true. The engine must hold the fund code as EMPLOYEE master data (it is the employee's statutory choice, not a company default), the 360-day service count, the CST art. 253 base including the transport allowance, the accrual-year period concept, the per-employee deposit-compliance status and, when the decree is enacted, the monthly-advance regime flag per contract. |  |
| 32 | - NOT DERIVABLE FROM THE MONTHLY FILINGS. The population is not the PILA population: an employee who left during the accrual year is EXCLUDED from the deposit and is paid directly in the final settlement (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4; Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)), while an all-inclusive salary employee is present in PILA and owed nothing here. The population must be generated from the Population Rules, never copied from a PILA return. Do not use the operator's seed-from-last-PILA convenience (E08). |  |
| 33 | - THE ONE-TO-MANY TRAP ON THE RETURN. Where the medio de pago is Pago Credito, the operator issues ONE RETURN NUMBER PER FONDO, so the reconciliation store must accept many return numbers for one payroll run (E05, E10). |  |
| 34 | - The engine must also produce two things that are NOT in this file and are commonly conflated with it: the 12% interest paid to the EMPLOYEE in January (IN01-IN03), and the tax figures that appear on Form 220 and Format 2276. Different payees, different deadlines, different penalties. |  |
| 35 | RESIDENT / NON-RESIDENT TREATMENT |  |
| 36 | - RESIDENT AND NON-RESIDENT ARE TREATED IDENTICALLY IN THIS FILING, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Severance savings is a LABOUR entitlement under the CST, not a tax concept, so it attaches to the employment relationship and not to tax residence. A non-resident foreign national employed under a Colombian contract accrues severance savings on the same base, at the same 360-day rate, is deposited to a fund of their own choosing and is reported in this return on exactly the same record as a resident. There is no non-resident variant of the layout and no withholding on the deposit. |  |
| 37 | - WHERE RESIDENCE DOES BITE IS THE TAX TREATMENT, WHICH IS NOT THIS FILING. For a RESIDENT, ET art. 206 num. 4 exempts the severance savings and their interest in full where the average monthly income of the last six months is at or below 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 in 2026), then tapers 90 / 80 / 60 / 40 / 20 per cent across the 350-410, 410-470, 470-530, 530-590 and 590-650 UVT bands, with nothing exempt above 650 UVT. For residents and non-residents alike, severance savings and their interest are never withheld (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 135 par. 3; DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.4.1.11; DIAN Oficios 8899 de 2015 and 4358 de 2019): the flat 20% of ET art. 408 does not apply to them, and a non-resident settles the tax in their own return. Neither outcome changes a single character of the record sent to the fund. |  |
| 38 | - THE DOCUMENT TYPE IS WHERE THE FOREIGN EMPLOYEE ACTUALLY BREAKS. The layout admits CE, PA, CD, SC, PE and (in the XLS variant) PT, and SOI records that a Special permanence permit number must be exactly 15 digits. A regularisation that converts a PEP or PPT into a Foreign resident ID card changes the join key (T03 + T04) that the fund holds, so the change must reach the fund or the following February's deposit lands on an orphan account. See T03 and T04. |  |
| 39 | - A Colombian employee posted abroad but retained on a Colombian contract remains in scope; an employee of a foreign entity with no Colombian employment contract is out of scope entirely, because there is no CST relationship to accrue cesantias on. |  |
| 40 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 41 | - CO-DIAN-004 (Form 220) casillas 48 and 49 - the same severance savings figures reported to DIAN for the employee's certificate. They must reconcile to this return. |  |
| 42 | - CO-DIAN-005 (Format 2276 v4) numerals 19 and 20 - the same figures again, and NOTE that numerals 19 and 20 are TRANSPOSED against Form 220 casillas 48 and 49. Map by meaning, per the CO-DIAN-005 Spec. |  |
| 43 | - CO-DIAN-001 (electronic payroll) - carries the severance savings and the interest as earning elements when they are PAID, on the payment-date rule. The XML shows the payment; this return shows the deposit; they are not the same event and can fall in different months. |  |
| 44 | - CCG Module 9 (termination and statutory benefits) for the base, the taper and the indemnity; CCG Module 10.1 report CO-RPT-006 and the consolidated 2026 filing calendar. |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - ANNUAL SEVERANCE-SAVINGS DEPOSIT TO THE EMPLOYEE'S CHOSEN FUND  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHO gets reported on the annual cesantias deposit and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Indefinite-term employee (indefinite-term contract) | YES | The core private-sector population. CST art. 47; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 5. |
| 7 | Fixed-term employee (fixed-term contract, max 4 years) | YES | Identical reporting treatment to an indefinite-term contract. CST art. 46; Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 6. |
| 8 | Specific-work or task employee (contract por obra o labor) | YES | An employment contract; CST art. 46. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 3 (Obra o Labor). |
| 9 | Occasional / accidental / transitory worker (< 1 month, non-core activity) | YES | Still an employee under CST art. 6. Reported on every filing; the PILA return type and the day counts differ, not the obligation. |
| 10 | Part-time employee | YES | Colombia has no separate part-time regime. Reported normally; the PILA contribution base is floored at 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905) except for the worker type 51 partial-time regime. |
| 11 | All-inclusive salary employee (all-inclusive salary, >= 13 SMMLV) | YES | CST art. 132 num. 2. Reported with the integral-salary flag set; the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, and the electronic payroll carries SalarioIntegral = true. |
| 12 | Apprentice (apprenticeship contract) | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19). |
| 13 | Intern / practical placement (practicas o pasantias) | YES | Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 5. Reported where remunerated. |
| 14 | Teleworkers and remote workers | YES | Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158). |
| 15 | Resident foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | Full reporting. Withheld under the ET art. 383 progressive table once tax residence is acquired. |
| 16 | NON-RESIDENT foreign national under a Colombian contract | YES | IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix. |
| 17 | Employed old-age pensioner in active service | YES | PILA worker sub-type 01; no pension contribution (PILA pension rate field = 0), health and the levies still apply. |
| 18 | Executive director / statutory legal representative holding an employment contract | YES | Reported as an ordinary employee where an employment contract exists. |
| 19 | Independent contractor (service contract) | NO | Not an employee. The contractor self-files PILA on 40% of fees (return types I / Y, descoped) and is reported by the payer in the third-party information return, not in this employer filing. Withholding on their fees does pass through Form 350, but under a different casilla. |
| 20 | Public-sector employee (contributor type 47, SGP-funded entity) | NO | Public-sector employment is outside the scope of this specification, which covers employees under the CST and Law 50 of 1990 art. 99; the PILA return types T and F that carry public-sector contributors are likewise out of scope. |
| 21 | Non-executive director paid fees only (junta directiva) | NO | Director fees (honorarios de junta directiva) are not paid under an employment contract, and cesantias is a prestacion social of the employment contract (CST art. 249; Law 50 of 1990 art. 99), so no fund affiliation and no return record exist for a fee-only director. Where the same person also holds an employment contract, that contract is reported as an ordinary employee (see the executive director row). The withholding on the fees is a Form 350 matter outside this filing. |
| 22 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by a fund, not by the employer | NO | The paying fund is the withholding agent and the reporting party, not the employer. |
| 23 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 24 | Annual severance-savings liquidation at 31 December | YES | T14. The whole purpose of the filing - one amount per employee per accrual year. |
| 25 | Basic salary of December of the accrual year | YES | T12, as the layout expressly requires: 'Corresponde al ultimo salario basico reportado en el mes de diciembre del ano causado de cesantias'. |
| 26 | Transport allowance inside the liquidation base | YES | Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7 treats the transport allowance as salary for the sole purpose of liquidating prestaciones sociales, so it is in the base (CST art. 253 sets the base). It is NOT a separate field - it is inside T14. The operator's own calculator omits it, which is the single most expensive trap in this filing; see T14. |
| 27 | Days of service on the 360-day commercial year | YES | T10, 1 to 360. Paid leave and recognised incapacity count as service. |
| 28 | Employee's chosen fund | YES | T09, one of the five codes 02 / 03 / 10 / 15 / 19. The choice is the employee's under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3. |
| 29 | Employee residential address, landline, e-mail | YES | T15 and T18-T19 - the fund needs them to communicate with its own member. Note it is the RESIDENCE, unlike PILA and the electronic payroll which carry the work location. |
| 30 | Contract hire date | YES | T20, and it is the HIRE date, not the start of the accrual period. See T20. |
| 31 | Interest on severance savings at 12% | NO | IN01-IN03. Paid DIRECTLY TO THE EMPLOYEE in January under Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1, never to the fund. Different payee, different deadline, different penalty. Shown on the Spec as not-applicable rows precisely because it is so often conflated with the deposit. |
| 32 | All-inclusive salary employees' severance savings | NO | CST art. 132 num. 2 - the all-inclusive salary ABSORBS the severance savings, so there is no deposit and the employee must not appear in the return at all. They DO appear in PILA, which is why the seed-from-PILA convenience at E08 is dangerous. |
| 33 | Partial withdrawals and advances taken during the year | NO | Not a field of this layout. CST art. 254 prohibits partial payment before termination except for the authorised housing and education purposes; a lawful partial settlement reduces the balance and the interest, and is evidenced separately. |
| 34 | Withholding tax on the severance savings | NO | No withholding is practised on the DEPOSIT. The tax treatment (ET art. 206 num. 4 for a resident, ET art. 408 for a non-resident) is settled when the money is PAID to the employee, and is reported on Form 220 and Format 2276. |
| 35 | Employer social-security contributions | NO | Cesantias is a prestacion social and is NOT part of the contribution base (Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 and CST art. 128 govern that boundary). Nothing about it appears in PILA. |
| 36 | A declared record count or control total inside the file | NO | The published layouts carry no header, no trailer, no record count and no control total (Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias' s. 3.2; see File Structure). The control is the total payable returned by the operator (E11), which is reconciled against the engine's own sum of T14 before payment, because a truncated upload is not self-detecting. |
| 37 | Pre-1991 retrospective-regime employees | PARTIAL | Employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not migrate remain on the retrospective annual-adjustment regime, which has NO annual deposit to a fund - the employer holds the liability and settles on termination. They are therefore out of this return, but they ARE reported as a separate line on Form 220 and Format 2276. Hold the regime as master data on the contract. |
| 38 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 39 | Reported on the accrual (causacion) date | NO | Every Colombian payroll filing is keyed to the PAYMENT or credit-in-account date, not to the accrual date. A December salary paid in January falls in the January filing. |
| 40 | Reported on the payment or credit-in-account date | YES | The universal Colombian rule - payment or credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276. |
| 41 | A semi-monthly payroll produces two filings a month | NO | It does not. The electronic payroll is expressly ONE monthly document per employee 'irrespective of whether the obliged party makes payments in different or shorter periods' (Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.2). PILA and Form 350 are likewise monthly. |
| 42 | Nil period still filed | NO | There is no nil return. The deposit is a payment per employee (Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3), not a declaration: the return consists of one record per employee in service at 31 December whose liquidation is at or above one day of one SMMLV (Population Rules Step 0; File Structure, minimum collection), and the layout has no header or empty-return construct. Where no employee meets the population rule for the accrual year, no return is built and nothing is deposited. |
| 43 | Corrections handled by re-filing the whole period | VARIES | Electronic payroll: NO - a dedicated adjustment note (NominaIndividualDeAjuste, Replace or Delete) referencing the original CUNE. Form 350: yes, a corrective return. PILA: a correction return type N (correcciones) for the period, filed through the same operador as the original return; the C records (correct values) must be equal to or greater than the A records (original values) in IBC and in days, and type N cannot be used for a correction that leads to a refund, which is requested from each administradora outside PILA (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8; Disposiciones comunes a la Planilla N). A return paid after its deadline is filed on type E; type M (mora) applies only to periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8). |
| 44 | **═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══** |  |  |
| 45 | Employee who left during the accrual year | NO | The severance savings of a leaver are settled IN THE FINAL SETTLEMENT and paid to the employee, not deposited to the fund in the following February. Only employees still in service at 31 December generate a return record. Including a leaver double-pays. |
| 46 | Employee hired during the accrual year | YES | One record, with T10 carrying the actual days of service on the 360-day convention and T20 still carrying the real hire date. |
| 47 | Employee whose liquidation is below one day of the SMMLV | NO | The layout rejects it: 'el valor minimo del recaudo debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano causado' - COP 58,363.50 for accrual year 2026. Such a residue is settled with the employee, not deposited. |
| 48 | Employee paid directly under CST art. 57 par. 4 | NO | Where the employer proves direct payment fehacientemente, the payment discharges the obligation and no non-deposit penalty applies - so no return record. BUT affiliation to a fund remains compulsory, and the discharge is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test. See E92. |
| 49 | Construction worker under CST art. 310 | YES | Construction works (CST art. 310 a), art. 312): severance at three days' salary per complete month worked (vs. 30 days per year under CST art. 249), payable at termination for any cause. Since Corte Constitucional C-078 of 2023 there is no one-month minimum: it is recognised proportionally to the time actually worked. Same return record; only T14 changes; the layout has no field to disclose the regime. |
| 50 | Apprentice under a apprenticeship contract | YES | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026, so the ordinary CST prestaciones including severance savings apply to the productive phase. |
| 51 | Employee who changed fund during the year | YES | One record, to the fund the employee has chosen at the time of the deposit. The choice is the employee's and is master data on the employee; a mid-year change must reach payroll before the February run or the deposit goes to the old fund. |

T10, T12 and T13 back-reference this field. | TXT positions 128-136 \| XLS column J | 9 | N (9) whole pesos, zero-filled | 002000000 | Mercans.Cesantias_Annual_Liquidation | Mandatory, nine integers. TWO RULES AND ONE TRAP. Rule one, the floor: 'el valor minimo del recaudo debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano causado' - for accrual year 2026 one day of the SMMLV of COP 1,750,905 is COP 58,363.50, so a record below that is rejected. Rule two, the override: the layout's own formula is salario basico * (dias trabajados / 360) BUT 'en este campo el aportante puede especificar un valor diferente y no se haran calculos automaticos de este valor'. THE TRAP: the operator's formula omits the TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE, which CST art. 253 requires in the base. For an employee on the 2026 minimum wage the operator would compute 1,750,905 while the statute requires (1,750,905 + 249,095) = 2,000,000 - a shortfall of COP 249,095 that is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary for every day of delay under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's own figure into this field and never rely on the portal calculator. WHAT IS DEPOSITED - NET OF DIRECT PAYMENTS ALREADY MADE: T14 carries the amount actually deposited for the employee = the consolidated 31 December balance (IN01) LESS the lawful partial payments already made directly to the employee during the accrual year (CST art. 254; Population Rules Step 1 (f)) and LESS any direct payment of that balance made in January to an employee who left before the deposit, which is lawful under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4. An employee who left and was paid in full in the final settlement is not in the return at all (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)). Keep the gross annual liquidation as a separate engine value: System Mapping 'Cesantias_Annual_Liquidation' is the gross figure, T14 is the net deposit. Wage-type mapping: the February fund deposit is wage type 25827 / 65805 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.'. The consolidated 31 December balance is the absolute value of wage type 63814 'Severance Balance (Current Month)' in the January period; it is the annual liquidation ('ces base' 68040 x days / 360) less the in-year direct payments 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay' (paired with 62117 'Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay' for the interest). A January direct payment of part of that balance is wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year', and the deposit then carries the remainder: 25827 (February) + 62126 (January) = \|63814\| (January). The engine does NOT generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service: CST art. 254 prohibits it except for the authorised housing and education purposes, so the only direct payments that reduce T14 for an active employee are those lawful partial payments; any other request to pay the consolidated balance directly to an active employee is rejected, and the balance is deposited in full. A full direct payment with fehaciente evidence is handled through E92. Where the remainder after direct payments falls below the one-day SMMLV floor the channel rejects the record and the residue is settled with the employee (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (5)). The base 68040 exceeds the December basic salary 63807 wherever variable pay is averaged under CST art. 253, which is why T14 must never be left to the operator's basic-salary formula. | Y | - | Whole Colombian pesos. Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect. | N | Amount | Per employee, per accrual year |  |  |

IN02 back-references this field. | NOT in this filing - paid directly to the employee | - | N (whole pesos) | 20000 | Mercans.Cesantias_Interest_Monthly | Law 2466 of 2025 art. 64 para. 2, verbatim: 'Las partes podran acordar por escrito la mensualizacion de los intereses sobre las cesantias, pagando al trabajador el 1% del salario base de liquidacion compuesto por el salario mensual sumado al auxilio de transporte en los casos en que a este hubiere lugar'. Two engine consequences. First, it needs a written agreement, so the flag is per contract. Second, the base is the monthly salary plus the transport allowance where payable, not the accumulated balance - so the monthly route and the annual route give different figures. The date the return was actually PAID, which is the date that matters for the deadline - not the date the return was built. Both operators separate settlement from payment: the return is liquidated, a pre-payment voucher is issued, and payment then follows by PSE or by credit. A return liquidated on 13 February and paid on 17 February is LATE. Store the payment date, not the liquidation date, as the compliance evidence. Composite Key: AAAA-MM-DD - positions 1-4 the year, 5 the hyphen, 6-7 the month, 8 the hyphen, 9-10 the day; the same 10-character date frame as T20, and the pair (E10 return number, E90 payment date) is the key of the compliance evidence held per accrual year. | Y | - | Not an amount - no rounding. | N | Date | Per return |  |  |
| 44 | Deposit compliance status per employee | Estado de cumplimiento de la consignacion por empleado | Deposit Confirmation, inbound | E91 | N | N |  | Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it | - | AN | ON TIME | Mercans.Cesantias_Deposit_Status | INBOUND / DERIVED. Per employee and per accrual year, one of ON TIME, LATE (with the day count), SHORT (with the shortfall) or DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT. This is the field that quantifies the exposure, because the Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3 penalty is one day's salary for EACH DAY of delay, PER EMPLOYEE, and uncapped - on 100 minimum-wage employees a fortnight's delay is of the order of COP 81.7 million. Recompute it from E90 against the deadline in the Report Matrix, and hold it for the employee's three-year limitation period (CST art. 488 as substituted by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 62). Where E92 records a discharge by proven direct payment, set this field to DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT instead of deriving it from E90 - see E92. | Y | -> Sheet 6: Estado de cumplimiento | Not an amount - no rounding. | N | Code | Per return |  |  |

E91 back-references this field. | Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it | 1 | AN | N | Mercans.Cesantias_Direct_Payment_Flag | CST art. 57 para. 4, added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, verbatim: 'Cuando el empleador acredite de manera fehaciente el pago directo al trabajador del valor correspondiente a las cesantias, dicho pago se considerara liberatorio de la obligacion, y no procedera sancion por no consignacion, salvo que se demuestre que el pago no se realizo en condiciones de libertad y que no fue utilizado en fines autorizados por la ley. No obstante, la afiliacion a Fondo de Cesantias es obligatoria.' Three limits the engine must respect: the discharge needs FEHACIENTE evidence, it is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test, and it does NOT remove the duty to affiliate the employee to a fund. A DRAFTING NOTE on the citation: art. 15's enacting formula announces only 'los paragrafos 2 y 3' of CST art. 57, yet the published text prints a Paragrafo 4 and this is it - so cite CST art. 57 para. 4 as added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, and expect the discrepancy to be raised. Wage-type mapping of direct payments: during the year, wage type 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay'; in January, wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year'; the fund deposit, wage type 25827, then carries the remainder of the balance. This flag covers a FULL discharge of the deposit obligation by proven direct payment (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (4)). An employee who left and was paid directly in the final settlement is NOT an E92 case but a Step 0 exclusion (2) under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4, and a January direct payment to an employee who left before the deposit is treated as that lawful payment. A partial direct payment does not set E92 = Y: T14 carries the deposit net of the direct payments already made and the record is still produced. The engine does not generate a direct payment of the consolidated balance to an employee who remains in service except for the housing and education purposes authorised by CST art. 254; such lawful partial payments reduce T14, and any other direct payment to an active employee is rejected. ### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ SUBMISSION CHANNEL ═══  

| Row | Channel | TWO channels, both through a licensed information operator, NOT through a government portal. (A) online_form - 'Planilla En Linea' (SOI) / 'Elaborar planilla' (Simple S.A.), each employee keyed into the operator's form. (B) file_upload - 'Liquidacion Por Archivo' (SOI) / 'Envio de Archivo Unificado de Cesantias' (Simple S.A.). Both channels are documented in both operators' published instructions. |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Portals | ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) - www.nuevosoi.com.co, instruction guide DDS-DES-INS-008 v2. Simple S.A. - www.pagosimple.com, 'Manual Severance savings'. The same service is offered by Aportes en Linea, Asopagos, Enlace Operativo and MiPlanilla, each of which may impose an operator-specific layout. This Spec is written to the SOI channel and the Simple S.A. layouts; the information operator used is a configuration setting, and this Spec defines no other operator's variant. |
| 5 | Authentication | Portal session with (company document type + number), (user document type + number) and a password. Simple S.A. states the credentials are the SAME ones used for PILA. There is NO certificate, NO electronic signature and NO machine-to-machine service - contrast CO-DIAN-001, which has a SOAP contract, a XAdES signature and a synchronous ApplicationResponse. |
| 6 | What comes back | A return number (one per fondo where the medio de pago is Pago Credito), a pre-payment voucher in PDF, and after payment the informe por fondo / por afiliado / completo in PDF or Excel. |
| 7 | NOT XML | No XSD, no cahier des charges and no XML of any kind exists for this filing. The word XML must not appear against CO-CESANTIAS-006. CSV is accepted by SOI as an upload format, but the two layouts published at field level are the fixed-width TXT and the XLS 97-2003, and this Spec is written to those. |
| 8 | **═══ LAYOUT A - FIXED-WIDTH TXT, 20 FIELDS IN 258 POSITIONS (PUBLISHED) ═══** |  |
| 9 | Source | Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias' s. 3.2 - 'Podras cargar un archivo plano o TXT sin encabezado; los campos deben estar organizados por posiciones'. |
| 10 | Record model | FLAT. One record per employee. Record type is the constant '02' in positions 1-2. There is NO type-01 header record, NO trailer, NO declared record count and NO declared control total - the aportante identity and the accrual year live in the portal envelope (Spec fields E01-E06), not in the file. |
| 11 | Encoding and line ending | Plain text. The instruction guide does not state the code page or the line terminator. Write ASCII with no accents and no special characters (both operators reject them in names) and use CRLF, which is what the Windows-oriented tooling in this space expects. |
| 12 | Size limit | SOI: a file above 1 MB must be COMPRESSED before upload. At 258 bytes plus a terminator per record that is roughly 4,000 employees per uncompressed file. |
| 13 | Sequence | Positions 3-7, starts at 00001, consecutive. Maximum 99,999 records. |

(2) The XLS admits PT (Permiso temporal) in column A; the TXT document-type list printed in the same manual stops at PE. Where the workforce includes PPT holders, prefer the XLS route or confirm PT with the operator. (3) The identity number is right-aligned and zero-filled to 16 in the TXT but plain numeric to a 15-character maximum in the XLS. A generator that shares one formatter across both routes will be wrong in one of them. |
| 57 | **═══ VALIDATIONS THE CHANNEL PERFORMS (BOTH OPERATORS) ═══** |  |
| 58 | Structure and content | Run on upload. Errors are returned as a downloadable Excel report; the file must be amended and re-uploaded. Nothing is partially accepted. |
| 59 | Asofondos affiliate-base check | Surnames and names are validated against the affiliate base that ASOFONDOS delivers to the information operators ANNUALLY. Differences produce an Excel report and a SI / NO question: SI overwrites the employer's values with the Asofondos values, NO keeps the employer's. Answer NO and fix the master data - see Spec field E09. |
| 60 | Minimum collection | Campo 14 must be at least one day of one SMMLV of the accrual year. For accrual year 2026: 1,750,905 / 30 = COP 58,363.50. |
| 61 | Character rules | No accents and no special characters (both operators list rejected characters); identity numbers without spaces, dots or punctuation; amounts without points, commas, decimals or signs. |
| 62 | What is NOT validated | The channel does NOT check the STATUTORY correctness of campo 14. It accepts any figure at or above the floor. In particular it will accept a liquidation computed WITHOUT the transport allowance, which is a short deposit penalised at one day's salary per day of delay. The only defence is to compute campo 14 in the engine. |

### Sheet: Population Rules

POPULATION RULES - HOW TO FILL EACH FIELD FROM PAYROLL  

| Row | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | **═══ STEP 0 - BUILD THE POPULATION (THIS IS WHERE THE FILING IS USUALLY GOT WRONG) ═══** |  |  |  |
| 4 | Population of the return | Payroll master data + service history | Select every employee IN SERVICE AT 31 DECEMBER of the accrual year who is on the annual severance savings regime (Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 - all employees hired from 1 January 1991, plus pre-1991 hires who migrated). EXCLUDE, in this order: (1) all-inclusive salary employees, whose severance savings is absorbed by CST art. 132 num. 2; (2) employees who LEFT during the year, whose severance savings was settled and paid in the final settlement; (3) pre-1991 non-migrated employees on the retrospective regime, for whom there is no fund deposit at all; (4) employees discharged by proven direct payment under CST art. 57 para. 4; (5) records whose liquidation falls below one day of one SMMLV, which the channel rejects. Do NOT build the population from the December PILA return, however convenient the portal makes it (E08): PILA is the population PAID in a month, not the population ENTITLED for the year - it contains every all-inclusive salary employee and omits every mid-year leaver. | A leaver included = double payment, and the money is then in a fund account the ex-employee must claim. A all-inclusive salary employee included = an unrecoverable deposit. A missed employee = one day's salary per day of delay, uncapped, running until it is found. |
| 5 | Fund per employee | Employee master data | Read Employee.Cesantias_Fund_Code. It is the EMPLOYEE'S statutory choice under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3 ('en el fondo de cesantia que el mismo elija'), so it is employee master data and never a company default. Where a mid-year change of fund has been notified, use the fund in force at the date of the deposit. Where the field is empty the record cannot be built - escalate, because affiliation is compulsory even where the severance savings is paid directly (CST art. 57 para. 4 in fine). Set E07 to N so that this per-employee value governs. | An empty fund code is not a payroll defect to be defaulted - it is an unfulfilled affiliation obligation. Answering YES to the portal's single-fund question to get past it deposits other people's money into the wrong fund and does not discharge the obligation. |
| 6 | **═══ STEP 1 - COMPUTE THE BASE AND THE AMOUNT (CST ARTS. 249 AND 253) ═══** |  |  |  |
| 7 | T14 Valor de las cesantias | Payroll engine - annual liquidation | Compute, do NOT let the portal compute. (a) Determine the BASE under CST art. 253: the LAST monthly salary if it has not varied in the last three months; otherwise, and for every variable salary, the AVERAGE of the last year of service, or of the whole period served if shorter. (b) ADD THE TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE where it is payable - Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7 treats the transport allowance as salary for the sole purpose of liquidating prestaciones sociales, so it enters the CST art. 253 base, and it is payable where the salary does not exceed 2 SMMLV (COP 3,501,810 in 2026). (c) Multiply by days of service over 360. (d) Round to the whole peso - not up to the next 100 as PILA requires, and not to the nearest 1,000 as Form 350 requires. (e) Validate against the floor of one day of one SMMLV (COP 58,363.50 for 2026). (f) Where a lawful partial settlement was made during the year under CST art. 254, deduct it. Write the result into positions 128-136, right-aligned and zero-filled, with '0000' in positions 124-127. | THE TRAP: the layout's own formula is 'Basic salary * (dias worked / 360)' and campo 12 is named 'basic salary'. Follow the portal and a minimum-wage employee is deposited COP 1,750,905 instead of COP 2,000,000 - a COP 249,095 short deposit per employee, penalised as non-deposit at one day's salary per day of delay. The floor also bites in reverse: a residue below COP 58,363.50 cannot be deposited and must be settled with the employee instead. |
| 8 | T12 Salario basico reportado en el ultimo mes | Payroll - December of the accrual year | Report the DECEMBER basic salary of the accrual year, exactly as the layout specifies ('Corresponde al ultimo salario basico reportado en el mes de diciembre del ano causado de cesantias'), in 9 integer positions, zero-filled, with '0000' in positions 111-114. This is a REPORTING field for the fund's records - it is NOT the statutory base, and the two will legitimately differ for a variable-salary employee whose base is a twelve-month average. Do not reverse-engineer T12 from T14 to make the portal's calculator agree. | For an employee who was on unpaid leave in December, or who was hired on 20 December, the December basic is still the contractual monthly salary, not the amount actually earned that month. For an employee whose salary changed in November, T12 carries the December figure while the CST art. 253 base is the twelve-month average - so T14 will not equal T12 * T10/360, and that is correct. |
| 9 | T10 Numero de dias worked | Payroll - service calendar | Count the days of service in the accrual year on the 360-day COMMERCIAL convention: each complete month is 30 days, a full year is 360. Include paid leave, paid holidays and recognised incapacity, all of which count as service. Exclude unpaid leave (unpaid leave) and suspension. For an employee in service the whole year write 360, rather than 365 and rather than 366. The field admits 1 to 360 only, so any computation that can produce 361 or more is wrong before it reaches the file. | A leap year does not change the divisor. An employee hired on 31 January accrues 330 days, rather than 335. Where unpaid leave straddles a month end, count the calendar days of the leave on the 30-day convention and subtract - do not subtract whole months. |
| 10 | **═══ STEP 2 - IDENTIFICATION AND CONTACT FIELDS ═══** |  |  |  |
| 11 | T03 + T04 Tipo y numero de documento | Employee master data | Map the document type to the two-letter severance savings code (CC/CE/TI/PA/CD/SC/PE, plus PT in the XLS route only) - this is a DIFFERENT mapper from the DIAN numeric codes used on Form 220 and Format 2276 and from the PILA list. Strip dots, commas, spaces and hyphens from the number, then RIGHT-ALIGN and ZERO-FILL to 16 positions for the fixed-width route, or leave it plain to a 15-character maximum for the XLS route. Where the type is PE the number must be exactly 15 digits. | A regularisation that converts a PEP or PPT into a Foreign resident ID card changes the join key the fund holds; unless the change reaches the fund, the February deposit lands on an orphan account and the employee cannot see it. A TI holder reaching majority is the same problem. Where the workforce includes PPT holders and the fixed-width route is used, the document-type list printed for that layout has no PT value - confirm with the operator rather than substituting CE. |
| 12 | T05-T08 Surnames and given names | Employee master data | Write the four name components into their own 20-position fields, left-aligned and space-filled: first surname (mandatory), second surname, first given name (mandatory), segundo nombre. Strip accents and every special character the operators reject. Where a component is absent, SPACE-FILL THE WHOLE FIELD - never shift the following fields up, because the record is positional and the fund code at 106-107 would then be read out of the middle of a name. Space-fill rather than truncate; a truncated surname mismatches the Asofondos base every year. Answer NO to the auto-adjust question (E09) and fix differences at source. | Compound surnames longer than 20 characters have to be truncated somewhere - do it deliberately and record the rule, because the same truncation must be applied consistently year on year or the mismatch report churns. A person with one name and one surname produces two space-filled fields, which is valid. Foreign employees whose passport shows a single name field need a documented split rule; the fund's record follows whatever was first sent. |
| 13 | T15-T19 Direccion, DANE, telefono, correo | Employee master data | Write the RESIDENTIAL address (not the work address - the fund communicates with its member at home), 50 positions space-filled. Split the DANE divipola code into its two-digit department half at 187-188 and its three-digit municipality half at 189-191. The landline field admits EXACTLY seven digits, so a 10-digit mobile cannot go in it; zero- or space-fill instead. The e-mail field is 50 positions and the operator validates the local part, the @ and the domain separately, with the hyphen barred from the first and last position of the domain. | The single most common defect here is sending the WORK municipality, because that is what PILA and the electronic payroll want; the affiliate then never receives a fund statement. Truncating a mobile number to seven digits produces a wrong-number record on the fund's file, which is worse than an empty one. Addresses longer than 50 characters must be abbreviated by a documented rule, not cut mid-token. |
| 14 | T20 Hire date | Contract master data | Write the CONTRACT HIRE DATE in AAAA-MM-DD, ten positions including the hyphens, at 249-258. For an employee hired in 2019 and reported for accrual year 2026 the value is 2019-03-01 - rather than 2026-01-01, and not the start of the accrual period. | Sending the accrual-year start corrupts the fund's seniority record, which the fund uses for its own member-benefit rules. For a rehired employee, use the hire date of the CURRENT contract, which is the contract the cesantias accrued under. Note the layout types this field N while the content contains hyphens; a strict numeric writer will emit 8 characters and fail validation even though nothing shifts, because the field is last in the record. |
| 15 | **═══ STEP 3 - ENVELOPE, PAYMENT AND RECONCILIATION ═══** |  |  |  |
| 16 | E01-E06 Return envelope | Company master data + run parameters | Authenticate with the company document pair, select the service CESANTIAS (not PILA), enter the ACCRUAL YEAR (not a month), select afiliacion type DEPENDIENTE, select the medio de pago and label the return with the run identifier so the returned return number can be tied back. Answer NO to the seed-from-PILA question and NO to the single-fund question. | The period concept is the trap: every other Colombian payroll filing is monthly and keyed to a payment date, and this one is keyed to the accrual year that closed on 31 December. A return built in February 2027 carries ano accrued 2026. |
| 17 | E10-E11, E90 Return values | Operator portal - inbound | Store the return number, the total payable and the PAYMENT date. Where the medio de pago is Pago Credito, expect and store MANY return numbers - one per fondo. Reconcile the returned total against the engine's own sum of T14 before paying, because the file carries no header, no trailer, no record count and no declared total, so a truncated upload is not self-detecting. Download and archive the voucher PDF and the per-fondo report. | Liquidating the return is not paying it. A return liquidated on 13 February and paid on 17 February is LATE - the deadline attaches to the deposit, so the compliance evidence is the payment date, not the liquidation date. |
| 18 | E91-E93 Compliance status and evidence | Engine-derived + fund certificate | Derive the per-employee status (ON TIME / LATE with a day count / SHORT with a shortfall / DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT) from E90 against the deadline, and hold it with the fund's deposit certificate reference for at least the employee's three-year limitation period under CST art. 488 as substituted by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 62. Quantify the exposure: the penalty is one day's salary per day of delay, per employee, uncapped - for 100 minimum-wage employees a fortnight is of the order of COP 81.7 million. | The certificate is issued by the FUND, but CCG Module 10 records that the EMPLOYER must be able to evidence it - so the reference must be stored employer-side, not left on a portal. A SHORT deposit made on time is not a lesser problem than a late one: the shortfall is treated as non-deposit and accrues the same daily penalty. |
| 19 | **═══ STEP 4 - THE TWO THINGS THAT ARE NOT IN THIS FILE ═══** |  |  |  |
| 20 | IN01-IN03 Interest on severance savings | Payroll engine - paid to the EMPLOYEE | Compute 12% per annum on the 31 December balance, pro-rated on days over 360, and PAY IT TO THE EMPLOYEE DIRECTLY DURING JANUARY of the following year - never to the fund and never in February. Liquidate no interest on interest. Where a WRITTEN agreement exists under Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 64 par. 2, pay instead 1% monthly of the monthly base (salary + transport allowance). Evidence the payment - failure costs an indemnity equal to the interest owed, once only, under Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1. | Two obligations, two payees, two deadlines, two penalties, and they are routinely conflated. Depositing the interest to the fund discharges nothing and leaves the January obligation open. Note also that the monthly 1% option and the annual 12% do NOT arrive at the same figure, because the monthly base is the monthly salary while the annual base is the accumulated balance. |
| 21 | Tax treatment of the cesantias | CO-DIAN-004 and CO-DIAN-005, not here | No withholding is practised on the DEPOSIT. When the money is eventually paid to the employee, a RESIDENT gets the ET art. 206 num. 4 exemption - full below a six-month average of 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 in 2026), then tapering 90/80/60/40/20 per cent across the 350-410, 410-470, 470-530, 530-590 and 590-650 UVT bands - while a NON-RESIDENT gets no exemption and the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. The figures are reported on Form 220 casillas 48-49 and Format 2276 numerals 19-20. | Format 2276 numerals 19 and 20 are TRANSPOSED against Form 220 casillas 48 and 49 - map by MEANING, per the CO-DIAN-005 Spec. Nothing about the tax treatment changes a character of the record sent to the fund, which is why a non-resident's record is identical to a resident's. |

The base is exactly two million, which makes the arithmetic below checkable by eye. |
| 6 | - | Liquidation | 2,000,000 x 360 / 360 = COP 2,000,000, deposited to Porvenir before 15 February 2027. | What the operator's own calculator would have produced: 1,750,905 x 360 / 360 = COP 1,750,905. A shortfall of COP 249,095 - see the trap note at the end of this sheet. |

| 9 | 00001 | T02 Secuencia (3-7) | First record of the return. | Must start at 00001 and be consecutive. Positions 1-7 together are the record key the operator's structure validation reads first. |
| 10 | CC | T03 Tipo de documento (8-9) | Citizenship ID card. | Two ALPHABETIC characters. Not the DIAN numeric code 13 that the same employee carries on Form 220 casilla 24 and Format 2276 numeral 2. |
| 11 | 0000001020304050 | T04 Numero de identificacion (10-25) | 1020304050, right-aligned and zero-filled to 16 positions. | Six leading zeros. In the XLS route the SAME number is written plain as 1020304050 to a 15-character maximum - one formatter cannot serve both routes. |
| 12 | PEREZ............... | T05 First surname (26-45) | PEREZ plus 15 spaces. | Left-aligned, space-filled. Dots shown here only to make the padding visible; the real file carries spaces. |
| 13 | GOMEZ............... | T06 Second surname (46-65) | GOMEZ plus 15 spaces. | Not marked mandatory. Had the employee no second surname, all 20 positions would be spaces - never omitted, or everything after position 45 shifts. |
| 14 | JUAN................ | T07 Primer nombre (66-85) | JUAN plus 16 spaces. | Mandatory. |
| 15 | CARLOS.............. | T08 Segundo nombre (86-105) | CARLOS plus 14 spaces. | Optional. Maps to the Data-Dictionary Other_Names field, shared with the electronic payroll and Form 220. |
| 16 | 03 | T09 Codigo del Fondo (106-107) | Porvenir - the employee's own choice. | Only 02, 03, 10, 15 and 19 are admitted. Had E07 been answered YES, this value would have been overwritten for every employee in the return. |
| 17 | 360 | T10 Dias worked (108-110) | A full accrual year on the 360-day commercial convention. | Not 365, and rather than 366 in a leap year. The field cannot carry more than 360. |
| 18 | 0000 | T11 Espacio con ceros (111-114) | Zero filler in front of the salary field. | 'Debe contener ceros'. Absent from the XLS layout. |
| 19 | 001750905 | T12 Salario basico reportado en el ultimo mes (115-123) | The December 2026 basic salary, COP 1,750,905, zero-filled to 9 positions. | A REPORTING field for the fund. It is the basic salary ALONE - the transport allowance does not belong here, only in the base of T14. |
| 20 | 0000 | T13 Espacio con ceros (124-127) | Zero filler in front of the cesantias value. | Same rule as T11. Together the two fillers make each amount a 13-position frame. |
| 21 | 002000000 | T14 Valor de las cesantias (128-136) | COP 2,000,000 - the CST art. 253 base of 2,000,000 for 360 of 360 days. | Above the floor of one day of one SMMLV (COP 58,363.50). Computed by the engine and written in, so no automatic calculation is performed. |
| 22 | CALLE 26 NO 68-35 APTO 502 | T15 Residential address (137-186) | The employee's HOME address, space-filled to 50 positions. | Not the work address. The fund posts member statements here - contrast PILA and the electronic payroll, which carry the WORK municipality. |
| 23 | 11 | T16 Department code (187-188) | Bogota D.C. | The two-digit half of divipola 11001. |
| 24 | 001 | T17 Municipality code (189-191) | Bogota D.C. | The three-digit half of divipola 11001. Writing 11001 here truncates to 110. |
| 25 | 6013456 | T18 Landline (192-198) | A seven-digit landline. | 'Solo admite 7 numeros'. A 10-digit mobile does not fit and must not be truncated. |
| 26 | juan.perez@empresa.com.co | T19 E-mail (199-248) | Local part, @, domain - space-filled to 50 positions. | The operator validates the three parts separately; the hyphen may be neither the first nor the last character of the domain. |
| 27 | 2019-03-01 | T20 Hire date (249-258) | The CONTRACT hire date, 1 March 2019. | NOT 2026-01-01. Ten positions including the hyphens, even though the layout types the field N. |
| 28 | **═══ RECONCILIATION OF THIS RECORD ACROSS THE OTHER COLOMBIAN FILINGS ═══** |  |  |  |
| 29 | 2000000 | Form 220 casilla 48 / 49 | The same cesantias figure reported to DIAN on the employee's annual certificate. | Casilla 49 is the amount deposited to the fund and casilla 48 the traditional-regime amount. For this employee, 49 = 2,000,000 and 48 = 0. See the CO-DIAN-004 Spec. |
| 30 | 2000000 | Format 2276 numerals 19 and 20 | The same figure again in the information return. | AND THEY ARE TRANSPOSED against Form 220 - numeral 19 and numeral 20 do not sit in the same order as casillas 48 and 49. Map by MEANING; a positional mapping swaps them and the error is invisible because both feed the same total. See the CO-DIAN-005 Spec. |
| 31 | 240000 | Interest at 12% - IN02 | 2,000,000 x 12% x 360/360 = COP 240,000, paid to the EMPLOYEE in January 2027. | Not in this file and not to the fund. Failure to pay costs an indemnity equal to the interest owed, once only (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1). |
| 32 | 0 | PILA | Nothing. Cesantias is a prestacion social and is not part of the contribution base. |  |
| 33 | **═══ THE FOUR TRAPS IN THIS RECORD ═══** |  |  |  |
| 34 | 249095 | Trap 1 - the transport allowance | The operator's formula is 'Basic salary * (dias worked / 360)' and would have produced COP 1,750,905. | The transport allowance is part of the cesantias base: Ley 1 de 1963 art. 7 treats the transport allowance as salary for the sole purpose of liquidating prestaciones sociales. Following the portal short-deposits COP 249,095 for this employee, and a short deposit is penalised as non-deposit at one day's salary per day of delay, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's figure into T14. |
| 35 | 360 | Trap 2 - the divisor | 360, rather than 365 or 366. | Both the statute and the layout use the commercial year. Using 365 understates every full-year liquidation by about 1.4%, which is again a short deposit. |
| 36 | 2019-03-01 | Trap 3 - which date | The hire date of the contract, not the start of the accrual year. | T20 is the field most often filled with 1 January of the accrual year. It corrupts the fund's seniority record for the member. |
| 37 | 11 / 001 | Trap 4 - which address | The RESIDENCE, split into the two halves of one DANE divipola code. | PILA and the electronic payroll want the WORK municipality; this file wants the home one. Reusing the PILA mapping sends the member's statements to the office. |

RECORD 1 - the ordinary full-year case, and the transport-allowance trap.  
Juan Carlos Perez Gomez, CC 1020304050, Porvenir (03), 360 days.  
December basic 1,750,905 (the 2026 SMMLV) in campo 12.  
Cesantias 2,000,000 in campo 14 = (1,750,905 + 249,095 auxilio de  
transporte) x 360/360, per CST art. 253.  
The portal's own calculator would have written 1,750,905. The COP 249,095  
difference is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary per day of  
delay under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped, per employee.  
RECORD 2 - a mid-year hire, no second surname, no second name, salary above  
2 SMMLV so NO transport allowance in the base.  
Ana Ramirez, CC 52987654, Proteccion (02), hired 1 June 2026.  
210 days of service on the 360-day commercial convention (7 x 30).  
December basic 4,200,000; base excludes the transport allowance because the  
salary exceeds 2 SMMLV (COP 3,501,810).  
4,200,000 x 210/360 = 2,450,000.  
Note positions 46-65 and 86-105: TWENTY SPACES each, not omitted. Omitting  
them would shift the fondo code out of positions 106-107 and every field  
after it.  
RECORD 3 - a foreign employee on a Special permanence permit, the  
state-owned fund, and the transport allowance applied correctly.  
Luis Marquez Silva, PE 123456789012345, Fondo Nacional del Ahorro (15).  
December basic 2,500,000, which is below 2 SMMLV, so the auxilio de  
transporte IS payable: base = 2,500,000 + 249,095 = 2,749,095, and  
360/360 gives campo 14 = 2,749,095. Contrast record 1, where the same  
rule was applied, and note that the portal calculator would have written  
2,500,000 here too.  
The PEP number is EXACTLY 15 digits, per the length rule in the SOI  
instruction guide, so positions 10-25 carry one leading zero and then the 15.  
A later regularisation to a Foreign resident ID card CHANGES the join key that  
the fund holds (campos 3 and 4) and must be notified, or the following  
February's deposit lands on an orphan account.

Asofondos name validation Excel difference report, if any - answer NO to  
the auto-adjust question and fix master data.  
After payment Informe por fondo / por afiliado / completo, in  
PDF or Excel; plus the fund's own deposit  
certificate, which the EMPLOYER must be able to  
evidence.  
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════  
DEADLINE FOR THIS SAMPLE  
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════  
Accrual year 2026 liquidates at 31 December 2026 and must be deposited BEFORE  
15 FEBRUARY 2027 (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3), so the last compliant day is  
Sunday 14 February 2027. Colombian practice moves a deadline falling on a  
non-business day to the next business day - for accrual year 2025 the shift  
from Saturday 14 February 2026 to Monday 16 February 2026 was reported in the  
Colombian press - but no MinTrabajo concept states that rule for this deposit,  
and the draft decree fixes mora as running "a partir del 15 de febrero".  
DO NOT RELY ON THE SHIFT: pay by Friday 12 February 2027.  
The penalty for getting it wrong is ONE DAY'S SALARY FOR EACH DAY OF DELAY,  
PER EMPLOYEE, UNCAPPED. For 100 minimum-wage employees a two-week delay is of  
the order of COP 81.7 million.

| 22 | DETAILED COMPLIANCE NOTES (Colombia-specific) |  |
| 23 | SUBMISSION CHANNEL |  |
| 24 | - Channel: upload of the two fixed-width files (or keying) on the web site of a licensed information operator chosen by the payer. Source: AT3 v15 ch. 1 s.0, p. 7. |  |
| 25 | - The planilla is self-settled and paid electronically: pension payers with 20 or more pensioners have been bound to the electronic modality since 6 March 2017 (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.3.9). |  |
| 26 | - Prerequisite: the payer must appear in the Ministry of Health file 'INFORMACIÓN PAGADORES DE PENSIONES', placed monthly on each operator's secure FTP; a payer that does not appear requests inclusion from the Subdirección de Pensiones y Otras Prestaciones (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, p. 16). |  |
| 27 | - The payer updates its File Type 1 registration with the operator in July and January, as a precondition for settling the planilla of that month (AT3 v15 §1.1, pp. 11-12). |  |
| 28 | SCOPE OF THIS REPORT |  |
| 29 | - Covers the pensions the employer pays directly as pension payer type 01, pensioner types 5 and 6, and the pensioner type 9 records of their additional UPC beneficiaries (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §1 table 3, pp. 100-101). |  |
| 30 | - Active employees, including employed pensioners in active service, are reported in the employees' PILA under Anexo Técnico 2 (CO-PILA-003), a different file with a different layout. |  |
| 31 | - Payments that are not a pension (for example an instalment of a retirement bonus) have no record here: every detail record carries a pension type (campo 9) and a mesada (campo 58). |  |
| 32 | CONTRIBUTIONS SETTLED |  |
| 33 | - Health: borne in full by the pensioner (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 143) on the mesada capped at 25 SMLMV; rate by total mesada and contribution period, from January 2024 4% (1 SMLMV) / 10% (more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV) / 12% (more than 3 SMLMV), earlier periods as in T2R2-048 (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5; Res. MSPS 1271 de 2023 art. 1). |  |
| 34 | - Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional, subsistence subaccount: 1% for a total mesada above 10 and up to 20 SMLMV, 2% above 20 SMLMV, on the mesada (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.2 and §2.2.2.21; Ley 797 de 2003 art. 8). |  |
| 35 | - Pension: only for pension types that contribute (11 and 14 'para compartir', 4; optional 12, 20, 21) per R6 (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §6 table 9, pp. 107-108); R6 also marks 7 and 22, which are not valid for payer type 01 (R02, AT3 v15 pp. 102-103). |  |
| 36 | - Family compensation fund: optional for every pension type (R6, 'O'). |  |
| 37 | - No occupational risk, SENA or ICBF in this file. |  |
| 38 | RELATED FILINGS / CROSS-REFERENCES |  |
| 39 | - The pensions paid by the employer and the deductions withheld from them are also reported in the electronic payroll (CO-DIAN-001): Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.5.3.2.3 includes 'pagos a los pensionados a cargo del empleador'. |  |
| 40 | - Totals records types 3 to 7 (pension, FSP subsistence, health, CCF and total payable) and the output files to the administradoras are generated by the information operator, not by the payer (AT3 v15 ch. 2-3, pp. 65-98). |  |


### Sheet: Payroll Scope Summary

PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY - INTEGRATED CONTRIBUTION SETTLEMENT RETURN OF THE PENSION PAYER (PILA PENSIONADOS)  
PURPOSE: Tell the developer WHO is reported on the monthly pensioners' planilla of the employer as pension payer, and what happens to a borderline case.  

| Row | SCENARIO | REPORT? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | **═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 6 | Pensioner whose pension the employer pays directly (pension WT 62154) | YES | The employer is pension payer type 01 Empleador: 'empresas públicas o privadas o personas naturales que tienen a su cargo el pago de pensiones de sus trabajadores' (AT3 v15 §1.2.4, p. 13). Pensioners are members of the contributory health regime (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 157) and the pension payer self-settles and pays their contributions through PILA (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.3.9; Res. MSPS 2388 de 2016 art. 1, Anexo Técnico 3). Pensioner type 5 or 6 (R01). |
| 7 | Survivor (sustitución) beneficiary of a pension the employer pays | YES | Pension types 2, 3 and 4 are valid for payer type 01 (R02, AT3 v15 pp. 102-103). The causante block (campos 11 to 16) becomes mandatory, and campo 63 carries the total of all beneficiaries (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.3, p. 47; §2.2.2.28, p. 64). |
| 8 | Additional UPC beneficiary of a pensioner | YES | Reported as an extra detail record with pensioner type 9, carrying only the fields listed in AT3 v15 §2.2.2.4 (p. 49). EXCLUDED from the header count (T2R1-014) and the header payroll total (T2R1-015). |
| 9 | Pensioner resident abroad without a family group in Colombia | YES | Reported with campo 18 = X: health rate 0% and health contribution zero for periods after December 2015, EPS may be blank, date of filing abroad mandatory (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.5, p. 49; ch. 4 §9, p. 113). The exemption covers the health contribution only; the FSP contribution above 10 SMLMV still applies (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.21, pp. 61-62). |
| 10 | Pensioner whose mesada is suspended in the month | YES | Reported with SUS = S; days = days of suspension, mesada and IBC zero (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.9, p. 51). |
| 11 | Active employee, including an employed pensioner in active service | NO | Reported in the employees' PILA under Anexo Técnico 2 (CO-PILA-003), which is 'Aportes a Seguridad Social de Activos' (Res. MSPS 2388 de 2016 art. 1). |
| 12 | Former employee paid a retirement bonus in instalments | NO | Not a pension: no pension type (campo 9) and no mesada (campo 58) exist for it, and the person is not an active contributor of Anexo Técnico 2. A payment that is in fact a periodic jubilación or convencional pension paid by the employer is reported here, with pension type 10 or 13. |
| 13 | Pensioner whose pension is paid by a pension fund or administradora | NO | Reported by that administradora as pension payer type 02 (AT3 v15 §1.2.4, p. 13), not by the employer. |
| 14 | **═══ AMOUNTS AND CONCEPTS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |
| 15 | Mesada (pension WT 62154) | YES | Campo 58, uncapped, and campo 63 (total mesada). The header payroll total T2R1-015 is the sum of campo 58 (AT3 v15 pp. 15, 38-39). |
| 16 | Health contribution of the pensioner (WT 21645 / 21646 / 21647) | YES | Campo 49 = campo 48 x campo 39. Rate on the total mesada, for contribution periods from January 2024: 1 SMLMV 4%; more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV 10%; more than 3 SMLMV 12% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5 with Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Res. MSPS 1271 de 2023 art. 1); earlier periods as in T2R2-048. Base = mesada capped at 25 SMLMV (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.13, p. 52). |
| 17 | Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional on mesadas above 10 SMLMV (WT 21643 / 21648 / 21644) | YES | Campo 47: 1% above 10 and up to 20 SMLMV, 2% above 20 SMLMV, on campo 58 (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.21, pp. 61-62; Ley 797 de 2003 art. 8). Days in campo 36. |
| 18 | Pension contribution | VARIES | Only for the pension types R6 marks X (4, 7, 11, 14, 22) or O (12, 20, 21); of the X types, 7 and 22 are not valid for payer type 01 (R02, AT3 v15 pp. 102-103), so for this employer the contributing types are 4, 11 and 14, and optionally 12, 20 and 21. Jubilación (10) and Convencional (13) carry no pension contribution: campos 30, 35, 40 and 41 stay blank or zero (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §6 table 9, pp. 107-108). |
| 19 | Family compensation fund (CCF) | VARIES | Optional for every pension type (R6 'O'). Where the pensioner contributes, campos 34, 38, 51 and 52 are populated: campo 52 = campo 51 x campo 58 (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.26, p. 63). |
| 20 | Income tax withholding on the pension | NO | This is a contribution settlement, not a tax return. Withholding goes on Form 350. |
| 21 | **═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══** |  |  |
| 22 | Monthly planilla | YES | Planilla type P is the main planilla for the monthly contributions of the pensioners (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, p. 16). |
| 23 | Retroactive pension or reliquidation of the mesada | YES | Separate planillas: R (retroactive), L (reliquidation of periods before January 2020), V (reliquidation from January 2020, A and C records) (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, pp. 17-20). |
| 24 | Payer not listed in the Ministry file 'INFORMACIÓN PAGADORES DE PENSIONES' | NO | Planilla types P, R, L and V require the listing. The payer first requests inclusion from the Ministry's Subdirección de Pensiones y Otras Prestaciones (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, pp. 16-20). |

### Sheet: File Structure

FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS  
═══ SUBMISSION FORMAT ═══  

| Row | Governing layout | Res. MSPS 2388 de 2016, Anexo Técnico 3 'Aportes a Seguridad Social de Pensionados', version 15 dated 24-07-2026 (cited as AT3 v15), incorporating up to Res. MSPS 1529 de 2026. |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | Channel | Upload of the two fixed-width flat files into the web portal of a licensed information operator, or keying on the same portal. The pension payer never transacts directly with the government for these contributions. |
| 5 | Electronic modality | Pension payers with 20 or more pensioners self-settle and pay through the electronic planilla (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.3.9). |
| 6 | Payer listing | Planilla types P, R, L and V require the payer to appear in the Ministry file 'INFORMACIÓN PAGADORES DE PENSIONES' (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, pp. 16-20). |
| 7 | Operator upload wrapper | The two files below follow the official annex position by position. Each operador's upload wrapper and any additional validations it applies are published by the operador and held in the information-operator configuration for the operador the payer has chosen. |
| 8 | **═══ FILE FORMAT ═══** |  |
| 9 | File type | Two fixed-width flat text files, one record per line: File Type 1 'Datos generales del pagador de pensiones' and File Type 2 'Información planilla integrada' (AT3 v15 ch. 1 s.0, p. 7). |
| 10 | Numeric fields (tipo N) | Right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left (AT3 v15 ch. 1 s.0, p. 7; §2, p. 13). |
| 11 | Alphanumeric fields (tipo A) | Left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right (AT3 v15 ch. 1 s.0, p. 7; §2, p. 13). |
| 12 | Record lengths | File Type 1 = 482 positions. File Type 2 Record Type 1 = 285 positions. File Type 2 Record Type 2 = 519 positions. All three equal the printed totals of AT3 v15 (pp. 11, 16, 39). |
| 13 | Rounding | The contribution base (IBC, campo 39) is rounded UP to the whole peso and each contribution value is rounded UP to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.1.5, text of Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1). AT3 v15 requires the rounding rules in force in campos 41, 42, 45, 46, 47, 49 and 52 (pp. 53, 59-63). |
| 14 | Rate fields | Campos 40, 48 and 51 are numeric, seven positions. AT3 v15 prints the decimal layout for campo 51: decimal, left-justified, zeros to the right, 2.0% = 0.02000 (p. 63). The layout of every rate field is held in the file-format configuration as published by the chosen information operator. |
| 15 | Registration update | The pension payer updates its File Type 1 data with the information operator in July and January, before settling the planilla of that month; the operator notifies a payer that has not updated at least two months in advance (AT3 v15 pp. 11-12). |
| 16 | **═══ RECORD STRUCTURE ═══** |  |
| 17 | File Type 1 | Datos generales del pagador de pensiones. 27 campos, positions 1 to 482. ONE record per payer (or per branch where the form of presentation is S). Sent with every payment and reported to the Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional and the administradoras (AT3 v15 §1, p. 7). |
| 18 | File Type 2, Record Type 1 | Encabezado. 18 campos, positions 1 to 285. ONE record per planilla, and it is the first record. Identified by record type 01 in positions 1-2 (AT3 v15 §2.1, p. 14). |
| 19 | File Type 2, Record Type 2 | Liquidación detallada de aportes. 63 campos, positions 1 to 519. At least ONE record PER PENSIONER, and one record per pension type where a beneficiary holds two types of pension; one extra record per additional UPC beneficiary (pensioner type 9). Identified by record type 02, sequence from 0000001 in positions 3-9 (AT3 v15 §2.2, p. 21; §2.2.2.4, p. 49). |
| 20 | Records Type 3 to 7 | TOTALS RECORDS GENERATED BY THE OPERADOR, never sent by the payer: type 3 total pension contributions; type 4 Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional subsistence subaccount; type 5 health; type 6 family compensation funds; type 7 total payable for the period (AT3 v15 ch. 2, pp. 65-72). |
