### Sheet: Population Rules

POPULATION RULES - HOW TO FILL EACH FIELD FROM PAYROLL  

| Row | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | **═══ WHO IS REPORTED ═══** |  |  |  |
| 4 | Population of Record Type 2 | Payroll engine | One detail record per pensioner whose pension the employer pays directly (pension WT 62154) and per pension type held, for every month the pension is in force, plus one pensioner type 9 record per additional UPC beneficiary. The employer files as pension payer type 01; the pensioner type is 5 (mesada capped at 25 SMMLV) or 6 (no cap) (AT3 v15 §2.2, p. 21; ch. 4 §1, pp. 99-101). | Employees, including employed pensioners in active service, go in CO-PILA-003. Instalments of a retirement bonus are not a pension and have no record. A suspended mesada is still reported, with SUS = S. |
| 5 | Payer listing prerequisite | Configuration | Before the first planilla P, R, L or V, the payer must appear in the Ministry file 'INFORMACIÓN PAGADORES DE PENSIONES' (monthly, operator FTP). Where it does not, it requests inclusion from the Subdirección de Pensiones y Otras Prestaciones of the Ministry of Health (AT3 v15 §2.1.2.2, pp. 16-20). | The listing is held by the Ministry and the operator; the engine records the payer's listing status as configuration and does not produce the planilla without it. |
| 6 | **═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 7 | Mesada and total mesada (T2R2-058, T2R2-063) | Payroll engine | Campo 58 = the mesada of the month (WT 62154), uncapped. Campo 63 = the total mesada: equal to campo 58 for a pension that is not shared (types 10 and 13 included); the sum of the shared amounts, of the Colombian and foreign mesadas, or of all survivor beneficiaries otherwise (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.27-28, p. 64). | Campo 63 drives the health band and the FSP factor; campo 58 is the base of the FSP and CCF amounts. Keep the two separate even where they are equal. |
| 8 | Contribution base (T2R2-039) | Payroll engine | IBC = mesada, capped at 25 SMLMV, rounded UP to the whole peso (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.13, p. 52; Decreto 780 de 2016 arts. 2.2.1.1.2.1 and 3.2.1.5). | Minimum 1 SMLMV for pension types 10 and 13 (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §7, pp. 108-109). Zero with SUS = S and for pensioner type 9. |
| 9 | Health rate and contribution (T2R2-048, T2R2-049) | Payroll engine | Select the rate on campo 63 for the contribution period: from January 2024 a mesada of 1 SMLMV 4%; more than 1 and up to 3 SMLMV 10%; more than 3 SMLMV 12% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 par. 5 with Ley 2294 de 2023 art. 78; Res. MSPS 1271 de 2023 art. 1); periods 2020-2023 as in T2R2-048. Campo 49 = campo 48 x campo 39, rounded UP to the next multiple of 100. The amount is the sum of the health WTs 21645 / 21646 / 21647 withheld from the mesada. | Pensioner abroad (campo 18 = X): rate 0% and contribution zero. With fewer than 30 days (ING / RET), the operator checks campo 63 against the proportion of the SMLMV for the days reported (AT3 v15 p. 64). |
| 10 | Fondo de Solidaridad Pensional (T2R2-036, T2R2-047) | Payroll engine | Where campo 63 exceeds 10 SMLMV: campo 47 = campo 58 x 1% (more than 10 and up to 20 SMLMV) or x 2% (more than 20 SMLMV), rounded UP to the next multiple of 100; campo 36 = days (30 for a full month). The amount is the sum of the FSP WTs 21643 / 21648 / 21644 (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.21, pp. 61-62; Ley 797 de 2003 art. 8). | Several pensions of one beneficiary in the same planilla: the factor follows the sum of campo 63 and applies to each campo 58. Campos 45 and 46 stay zero for pension types 10 and 13; the operator liquidates them only for the contributing types. |
| 11 | Days (T2R2-035 to T2R2-038) | Payroll engine | 30 for a full month whatever its calendar length; fewer only with ING or RET. Health days mandatory; pension days only for the contributing pension types; FSP days where the mesada exceeds 10 SMLMV; CCF days where a CCF is reported (AT3 v15 §2.2.2.10-12, pp. 51-52). | Health days zero only with campo 18 = X; 30 for a pensioner type 9 record. |
| 12 | **═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 13 | Header-to-detail consistency | Engine (validation) | T2R1-003 to T2R1-009 equal File Type 1 campos 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 5 and 6; T2R1-016 equals A1-027; T2R1-017 equals A1-025. T2R1-014 = number of pensioners in Record Type 2 excluding pensioner type 9; T2R1-015 = sum of campo 58 excluding pensioner type 9 (AT3 v15 §2.1.1, pp. 14-15). | The type 9 exclusion applies to both the count and the payroll total. |
| 14 | Coherence tables R01 to R6 | Engine (validation) | Before submission check: pensioner type against payer type 01 (5, 6, 9); pension type against payer type 01 (2, 3, 4, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 20, 21); pension type against pensioner type (R03); planilla type against pensioner type (R04); change events against pension type (table 8); subsystems against pension type (R6) (AT3 v15 ch. 4 §1-6, pp. 99-108). | A combination outside these tables makes the operator reject the whole planilla. |
| 15 | Payer and pensioner identities differ | Engine (validation) | The pensioner's document type and number must differ from the payer's (AT3 v15 p. 39). | The exception for pension type 16 (foreign pensioners under international agreements) does not arise for payer type 01. |
| 16 | Change event to date interlock | Engine (validation) | ING with campo 55, RET with campo 56, VSP with campo 57, SUS with campos 60-61; each date must fall within the period settled. TDE, TAE, TDP, TAP and campos 31 and 33 are always blank (AT3 v15 §2.2.1, pp. 29-39). | VSP and SUS are not reported together. |
| 17 | **═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══** |  |  |  |
| 18 | Rounding is UP | Engine (formatting) | IBC rounded UP to the whole peso; each contribution (campos 41, 42, 45, 46, 47, 49, 52) rounded UP to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.1.5, text of Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1). | Reconcile with payroll on unrounded values with a tolerance of 100 pesos per contribution. |
| 19 | Numeric and alphanumeric justification | Engine (formatting) | Numeric fields right-justified and zero-filled; alphanumeric fields left-justified and space-filled (AT3 v15 ch. 1 s.0, p. 7). | An empty numeric field is a run of zeros, an empty alphanumeric field a run of spaces. |
